amma n mi wyegye , wo to zhin nyaho nkwo kunce awu wom .
dudu lonu wo ku na ge wo ɓa lo nɓeda yi n kaisar aba , omihin mi to nɓodo yi lo nmi ɓa zhin m , sai ma tnu woi .
ama mɓa ka kniɓeyi ma ga esu dnagmayi hi a ?
ntu ge mi to gye wo laifi , na gna ge wa zhin m , cenu a zhin mi ɓe nwo yi n fye abye vinya , oho esu agaribas ha mwi wo , ha wu mi nya mi ɓa ka .
ntu ge kwo ta wu mi lo dei-dei ma tnu n za wan-wan yi n esu dnagmayi aba ntna ɓo tukwo m . ”
agaribas wa gna bulus ge , “ gya bye ha gna yi ho ɓeda . ” bulus wa wu obwa , wa ya ɓeda da .
wa gna , mi gye mihin tukwo esu agaribas nzhin arzikida nu , shi mi ye ma da mihin ɓeda nho abye .
ntu gemi kpe lo ge , ho zhin oza nu , n wo kpe ayahudiyi owa ye ɓedo n ɓa akunnu yi .
nsayi mi gyi ho wye ha kna tnubua .
“ ayahudiyi kpe lo sarai ge ma ku makaranta ayahudiyi nya zhin dna tarsus , avun ma ɓe urushelima ma ku aɓo zhin dei-dei .
ɓa ɓei ɓa ye ɓa da , ɓa kpe lo ge mi zhin farisiyi nu nwo ta ye ge afua wye n ayahudiyi owa yi ɓedo nɓa akunnu yi m .
ama dalili nkwo zhin ɓai ga mi laifi nyi kwo lo gbo , ɓa ga mi laifi ge mi na wyetu yi ntu alkawali nu ɓo n shekwoyi ɓo zhin ga eyi azakwoyi nyi .
a israilayi abye ngun awo-cei-aba , ɓa zhin atna nyipyei n sukwoyi ge ɓa gye alkawali ye nunu nɓa ʼsa , ama nsayi ɓa la mi ze laifi da .
kwo zhin laifi nu ge oza wa ga gaiciya ge efi kala ku lo ?
kwo to zhin gaiciya nu ge shekwoyi n iko yi lo wa je za wye-wyei gan ?
“ n ɓei zhin mi gye ngye kwo bmiya lo ma ga aza wahala n ɓa vi yesu nyi .
nɓo ku aza fi n kurkuku n mwa begye n urushelima , n iko amalami dnagmayi nya yi , esa nɓa da aza owa ofi nya , kwa da mi har ma ye nɓei nɓa zhin nyi . ”
mi ɓei zhin ma ga a yesu viyi wahala abaho-baho yi , mi ye ge ɓa na yesu aɓo .
mi ɓei pyena nɓayi , mi zan ɓa shin azhi yakwo , akniyi gbo-gbo .
- 13 “ n wyihoi mi lo ɓa zanshi n dimashika , mi la izni gwo n malami , dnagmayi , n nyipyei na tukwo , buzangna dnagmayi ndu nyipyei nya , kwa bmiya fi yi ɓedo aza yi nɓa ɓo gnisun n mi yi .
eyi vinya ya miya zhi nkni , ma wo begye kwoi daɓo n mi yi n ibraniyi bye yi , kwoi gna shawulu , shawulu kniyi nu zhin hoi ga mi wahala ?
ho ga hohin nu wahala .
“ ma nya ge , ‘ nkanu hoi ya ? ’ dagayi wa ye ga gna , ‘ omi nu yesu n ho ga wo wahala nyi .
laka !
ntu ge mi la ho kni ha ze mi fyenu n mi saida da yi , ce na zhin mi wu mihin tukwo n ho aba .
ho ɓa gna anyi aɓo ho ku gye , n aɓo n ho ɓa gye , esa n ma wu mihin tukwo n ho aba .
nɓa kna ho n ho azaje aba ɓedo abyedo yi .
nɓa tnu ho n abye do aba ,
ha kpe ɓa awye ya , ɓa gye gaiciya ɓa ye abui , ɓa zan-zan dna buzangna shekwoyi nya , maimakon shetan wyegma , ntu ge ɓa bwa gafara oɓa alaifi nya , ɓa ze gado shekwoyi nya , ɓedo aza yi abaho-bahoi vinya , oɓa nu a la oɓa alaifi zhan ya ntu ɓa gaiciya ga ɓo omi aba . ’
“ ntu deye ɓo , o esu agaribas , mi to ɓei na ɓo n ɓewyegye eshe nya yi m .
ma ya waʼazi zhin ga aza n dimashika mi , n urushelima yi ɓedo n yahudiya ekni yi , n jesun n abyedo aba , mi-i gna ɓa ge ɓa fwa alaifi ɓa pmibma ɓe shekwoyi aba , ɓa wu oɓa bmapmi a tnu-tnu manayi .
a yahudiyi ɓa wan mi dna aduwa nyakun ntu waʼazi zhin ɓo , ɓai ye ɓa wu mi .
ama shekwoyi wa mi gni , cenu zhin mi gni n wye-wyei n naiye , ma gna aza dnagmayi n aza anawyi yi gaiciya ye .
mi ta wu nyaho lo gbo n nya yi annabi edo n musa yi ɓei da m .
nge masihu ɓa sin wahala , wa ze oza kmisunyi n wo ɓo laka la evingwo , wa ɓe n buzangna yi na yahudiyi aba ɓedo n abye do yi . ”
festus wa da ɓo nkalayi ngye wa kaya nshe , wa ci ge , “ bulus ho la cenya .
oho nyaba nmwa la tukwo pmi ho ya ! ”
ama bulus wa gna , “ mi ta cenya nu m , festus duduyi , ama mi da gaiciya nu behinhin .
esu agaribas kpe aɓeye lo , mi da ɓeda ye n bugba kala yi , ntu ge aɓeye to zhin aɓo woi-woi nu nwo aba m , ntu ge ato zhin ɓa n vi nu m .
esu agaribas ha ga annabi gaiciya !
mi kpe lo ha ga gaiciya . ”
agaribas wa gna wo ge , n aɓedeye yi ho ye ma ze yesu viyi-i ?
bulus wa ye wa gna , mi gyi shekwoyi wye lo omi ɓeda kwa zhin ho ɓedo aza yi vinya nɓa zhi lo ya , ɓa ku ze ngye mi , sai dai to ngye agma n ɓa fi n mi nyi m .
sai esu , n gwamna yi , barniki aza yi vinya ɓa kukala ɓa kunya .
shi ɓa ɓo zhin shaula ɓa gna , “ oza deye to zhin laifi n wo ɓa fi ko a dna wo n kurkuku m . ”
agaribas wa gna festus ge , wo to ɓei ku gna ge , wo ɓa lo n ɓeda yi n kaisar aban , o la wo loya .
shi a ɓo ku shiri zo zhin , ntu geakuyialonyin roman eya nuwan nya yi , a ku a bulus ɓedo aza wan-wan ajei , fi n akurkuku guyi tukwoda ho akun , ai yi wo eye ge jiliyos , esu gu yi nu ɓei n woi .
ya kuka n ʼya yi , nkwo ɓa lo kwoi kpegni aba yi mwabegye lo ce yi n turki edna gbe .
aristakus ɓei gnisun n yi .
shi efye ɓei gyi ya si sida , jiliyos wa ye ge bulus wo la gmi gni wa ɓi anugundo gna , ɓa gwo wo agmadayi .
shi yi ɓo je lo fi eya , ese dnagmayi kwa ci , to ya mi ya dna eya n zokwo m , har kwa zhin ya duya saiprus sunbwa .
ya duya vivi n silisiya yi , n panfiliya yi , ya ɓe ya kpezhi n mira n lisiya ekni .
nɓo nu eyi tukwoda wato jiliyos , wa gye eya a masariyi nya , kwoi gmi alekzanderiya , kwoi lo italiya wa ku yi fi nkwo .
- 8 yi ɓo ku anyipyei bwa n mwa , yi sun wahala n eya dna yi , ya si kimdus deca , ese kwoi gna kala bwa-bwa , ya duya vivi n karita , ya lo salmoni .
n wahala yi , ya lo peceye peceye , yi lo edna ʼgbe yi har ya ɓe aba ho a yi kwo ge akpezhiba manayi , vivi ezhi hoi a yi kwo laisiya .
ya ku kpe zhi ɓo anyipyei n mwa begye .
ntu ge wahala ɓo nyi n aɓa zan-zan n kpai nyi , ntu ge vinyikwo ɓo la shi , bulus wa gna a kurkuku gu yi tukwoda ge .
“ ofye , mi gye lo wahala lo abye , kpekni yi ɓa sin asala eya kwa ɓaya , akaya ɓa bwi , aza ɓa bwa nyasan har efi . ”
ama akurkuku guyi tukwoda to wa wo bulus ɓe da m , sai aya dna yi tukwoda ɓeda .
shi kwo nyi akpezhiba manayi to ɓei bmiya n ɓa ɓa zhi n vinyikwo yi m , ayadna yi ɓa gna ge a zhin atna a lo finiksa ɓo fi ɓo n vinyikwo yi .
finiksa ɓei zhin ayakpezhi ba manayi nu .
esa fyewyi ese kwa ya ci peceye ɓa gye ngye kwo bmiya lo ɓa kuka , ɓa lo eya ya , ɓa ya lo vivi edna ʼgbe yi .
- 15 esa sun fyewyi ese nyakwo kwa ya ci n kala yi , kwa ce eya abwaya lo cei nla .
ɓa zhin atna ge ɓa jeze ɓe n eya yi la gbe , to ɓa mi m , ɓa fa kwo kwa ce kwa vi ese lo .
ya duya n muse ɓiyi ho avun , a yi muse yi ge kalauda , nɓo nu n yi ɓo wankma deca , n aya ɓiyi-ɓiyi bmazhin yi ,
ya mi ya gyi eya nawyi .
ayadnayi ɓai wo dna ge kpesun ese ɓa ce eya abwaya har kwa lo afrika , kni , ntu deye ɓo , ɓa aje loya nɓa gyi eya she nyi .
shi efye ɓo gyi , ɓa gye ese kwoi gna cici , eya atnu-tnu yi ɓa ya akaya kunya fi n nuwan .
dna nyipyei tahi , ɓa kun eya atnu-tnu kaya anya yi vinya ɓa she ɓa ya .
ese yakwo kwa ci nkala yi to kwoi shan fa m har anyipyei mwa begye , ngmayi , har ɓa bugba gmiya n pwo-pwo ɓo yi .
to aza yi gyi nyagyi m , ama bulus wa yi aya tnu-tnu-zhin yi wa gna ɓa ge , “ ofye , fye ɓo gna fya wo mi ɓeda nkmisunyi , to ye kuka n akpezhiba manayi m , to yo sin asara ye m .
ama agu tu yi ngye apma , zaho-zahoi ta bwi wo wye-wyei nuwan , eya ɓa ɓaya .
“ ntu ge nsukwoyi naiye , malaika omi shekwoyi nya , n mi zhin wo bauta nyi , wa ɓe mi aba .
woi gna mi ge , ‘ bulus to wo edna m , ntu ge shekwoyi ku howyegyi wo , sai ha gni agni n kaisar abye , woi ɓa aza gni , nɓa gnifi n ya n hoi nyi ’ .
ntu cenu fye ku mi zhi , ntu ge mi la gaiciya ga shekwoyi , kwo ɓa ze lo nu ngye shi wa da .
ama eya ɓa ɓaya ya wankma kpe n muse ho . ”
dna nyipyei awo-cei-nyihi , ogma ɓedo n ʼse yi n sadu sa , yi kpe n nuwan adriya nya , yi lo nawyei , na vuyi ese yi ce yi abwa ya , aya dnayi ɓa gye ngye yi ku wu vivi nkma yi .
ɓa mwi nuwa lolo ɓa gye kafa 120 .
esa fyewyi ɓa je mwi , ɓa gye kafa 90 .
shi ɓa ɓo gye lonu , ɓa kpe ge yi ku ga okma si , ama ntu edna ɓo ge kpekni agye akuta nyi ndna gbe , ɓa ya eya akpegninya fi nuwan ngun-anyi , ɓai shin-shin ge efye kwo gyi .
aya dnayi ho , ɓai ye ge ɓa busi ɓa fwa eya , ɓai la ya ɓai lo eya ɓiɓiyi ɓai zhin ngye ɓa ye ɓa ya eya kpegninya fi n nuwan nabye bwa .
ama bulus wa gna asoja ɓedo nɓa tukwoda yi ge , “ fye ɓa ku fi vinya sai dai ozaho-zaho yi wa kpe dna n ya .
asoja ɓa zun owun ya , ɓa fwa eya ɓiɓiyi kwa kaya . ”
shi efye ɓo la gyi , bulus wa gyi aza wye ge ɓa ku nyagyi gyi wa ci ge , “ fye ku sun nu , a mako ngun aba to fyei to nyagyi wo m .
mi gyi fye wye fye ku nyagyi ntu fye lafiya ɓo !
ntu ge kwo tukwoyi gmanyi oza ho nya , kwo ta bwi m . ”
shi wo ɓo zo da lonu , wa la bredi wa zhin shekwoyi godiya nɓa abye vinya , wa sa wa gyi .
nsayi-sayi oɓa vinya ɓa bwa sauki ɓa ya nyagyi gyi .
aza vinya tagyi aba , ncei shi tnaba cei tnanyi ( 276 ) eyi yewa nu n yi ɓei fi n eya yi vinya .
shi aɓo ku nyagyi gyi aya atnu-tnu yi ɓa kun alkama ɓa she ya fi n nuwan eya shanwo kwa ce gmiya .
shi efye ɓo la gyi , to ɓa kpe aba nɓa zhi-n ama ɓa ta wye ɓa gye okma n amwi yi , ɓa zhin shaula ge kwo ese ɓa ce ɓa bwaya fi akuta , kwa kun ɓa va kpe na mwi .
ɓa gna ɓa ɓa zhin atna ɓa gbe awun ya ɓa fwa eya akpezhi nya ya fi n nuwan , ɓa ya eya avun , ɓa ku eje wu abye ɓa lo edna gbe .
ama eya tukwo kwa lo kwa bi dna n amwi .
eya tukwo kwa bi dna dei-dei , eya avun kwa la wu , nuwan dokwo kwoi ɓe kwoi lu kwo nkalayi har eya kwa ya ɓaya .
asoja ɓa gna oɓa tukwoda ge , ɓa ku aza wan-wan wu vinya kada oza ho nɓa mi wa she nuwan wa piya wa busi .
ama jiliyos to ɓei ye ge awu bulus m , wa gna ɓa ge a to zhin lo nu m .
wa gna ɓa ge oza n wo ɓa mi wa she nuwan wo she wa piya tu nkma .
aza nɓa ce nyi , ɓa zhin atna ɓa wan eya apisayi ɓa wan kma .
elonu aza vinya ɓa ku wan kma n lafiya yi .
esa fyewyi ya kpe ge muse n ya wankma kpe nyi , a yi kwo ge malita nu .
aza nɓa ɓei fi ɓo nyi ɓa wu yi yeye , ɓa ku ena fin yi ya wye ntu ogma ɓo nkwo ɓo lu yi , ese yi fu yi nyi .
ngye shi bulus ɓo ku ashinwan wa ya kpe nna , gbezhi kwa kun ntu gugurgu ɓo , kwa knanyi bulus nbwa .
shi a malitayi ɓei gye kwo shegyi n bulus bwa , ɓa gna aje ge , “ ozaye zhin zawuyi nu ɓehinhin !
wo la pwo n nuwan , ama ɓenukwoyi kwo nu ta ye ge wo pwo m . ”
ama bulus wa mi kwo ya fi n na , wa ce wo nya gni ntna ɓoho .
aza yi bwa zhi ɓai gye ge , esa fyewyi wo ɓa ya sun , wa miyashi wa fi , amma shi ɓa ɓo gye esa la mwa to ɓoho kwoi zhin wo m , ɓa ɓeda shando ɓa gna ge , wo zhin shekwoyi ho nu .
vivi aba yi n yi ɓo wankma nyi , oza ho ɓei nyi ɓo a yi ge bubliyus , wo nu ɓo zhin gwamna muse yi nya .
wa gwo yi n bugba bui-bui yi , wa ga yi nyagyi har anyipyei ngun-ata .
bubliyus dada wo ɓo n nyasan yi , nayi nagun ɓedo n goro-san yi .
bulus wa lo wa zhin aduwa , wa to wo bwa wa wo kagna .
azaje vinya , nɓa to ɓei n lafiya yi m n muse yi , ɓa ɓe a ɓa kagna .
ntu deye ɓo aza ɓa ɓe yi n kyauta yi n mwa , esa nu yi ɓo ye ya kuka , aza ɓa ɓe yi na nya yi gbo-gbo n yi ɓa zhin akma n cei n zokwo .
apya ɓo ku sun ngun-ata , ngye shi eya ɓei ɓaya , ya kuka njesun , nsa deye yi ɓo zan-zan n eya alekzandariya nya yi nkwo zhin vinyikwo shi n muse hi , ai yi kwo ge “ aza aba . ”
eyi akpezhiba kmisunyi sai sirakusa , ya bwa anyipyei ɓo ngun-ata .
ya kuka ɓo ya pmi lo rigiyum , ya bwa nyipyei gmanyi ese kudu nya kwa ya ci , nyipyei bahi yisi butiyoli ,
nɓo ya sun a yesu viyi hoi , ɓa gyi yi wye ge yi ku fi nɓa yi har anyipyei tnaba .
ya kpe kala ku ya lo roma .
eyi azaje nɓa ɓei fi n roma nyi , ɓa ku wo ge yi ɓe lo , ɓa ɓe shegun yi n abiyu gnikwo .
azado ɓa shegun yi n ashiragyi ngun-ata .
shi bulus ɓo gye ɓa , wa zhin shekwoyi godiya , wa bwa bugba kala .
shi yi ɓo si roma , a ye bulus ge wo dna wo nya abaho-baho n wo ɓa dna , sai dai soja ɓei zhin woi gu wo .
shi wo ɓo si wa bwa anyipyei ngun ata , wa yi a yahudiyi atukwoda wa da ɓo nɓai wa gna , “ omi azaje , a yahudiyi nɓa fi n urushelima nyi , ɓa na wan mi ɓai dna mi a romayi akun , ko shi ko nyi mi to zhin nyaho-nyaho yi m , ko ma zhi za wuya kwo ɓo n kwo zhin kunnu eyi azakwoyi nya m .
“ a romayi ɓa ku owa da mi , ɓai ye ɓa ya mi , ntu ge ɓa to sun nyaho n mi aba nkwo kunce lo nfi yi , ngye shi a yahudiyi atukwoda ɓei gna ge awu mi nyi m .
shi a yahudiyi atukwoda to ɓo ye a shaula yi m , to a wun aje bugba m , ma gye ko la mi ze tile ma gyi abye n ɓeda yi kwa lo kaisar aba .
ma yi fye ge fye ɓe n naiye ge ya kpe ajeye , magna fye ge , mi dna n agma ye ge , mi n gaiciya ga yi lo ge masihu wa ɓe nu . ”
ʼba ye ɓa gna wo ge , “ yi to wo ɓoho tu nho tukwo m !
yi to bwa wasika n yahudiya , ko naza nɓa kun lo n urushelima , ɓai ɓe iya nyi m .
ama yi ce pma ya wo enya ho gaiciya yi ga , enya dei n yi kpe lo , okwo nu ge abaho-bahoi vinya , aza ta ye a yesu viyi lo m . ”
ɓa esa shi , nwyihi aza nmwa begye ɓa yezhi n wo puwa .
wa daɓo n ɓai tu shekwoyi ebemi ɓo , woi wu ɓa aɓo ntu yesu ɓo ngye shi aka fi n littafi gyi-gyi-yi , wa ya ɓa wu n attaura musa nya ɓedo anabi yi , wa ya ɓa wu n labmi yi har wyeshe !
azaho ɓa ku gaiciya ga , ama azaho to ɓa gaiciya m .
ɓa na bo aje yi n mwa , ɓa kuka n ɓeda gmanyi shi n bulus ɓo da ge , “ zafun gyi-gyiyi ɓo ku ɓeda da cewo n anabi ishaya gbe ge ,
“ wa gna a yahudiyi ge , ‘ fye ɓa wo fyei gye ama fye ta bwa awyega m ,
ntu ge ofye abugba shin-shin lo , ofye atnubua ta ye lo ɓa wo m , fyei ku fye awye kpe to fya bwa awye gam , ntu ge fye ta ye lo fya gye , fya wo , fya bwa awye ga , fya ɓe ma ka fye gna m . ’
- 29 mi ye fya kpe ge , gni-gni shekwoyi nya ye , kwo nyi ntu abyedo ɓo nu ce , ɓai ɓa gwo kwo . ”
bulus wa wo nya dna n wohin haya nyakun har aye ngun aba , woi gwo azhiɓeyi doho-doho nɓa ɓei ɓe wo wyegye .
woi gna ɓa shekwoyi ebe mi ɓo , n dagayi yesu kristi yi , zaho-zaho yi to ɓo wo wo ɓi m .
anugundo ye-yeyi n fye fi n roma nyi , wasikaye gmi n bulus akun nu , yesu kristi bara kni-kniyi ntuge wa zhi waʼazi , shekwoyi nabari manayi nya .
shekwoyi ɓei zhin nabari manayi ye alkawali tunyi nsapai , nwo anabi akun dna alkawali kwo-kwoyi .
kwo zhin nabari manayi nwo nugun tukwonu , yesu kristi eyi dagayi n wo ɓei ɓe ngye oɓi a mawo dna dawuda esu abe ɓi fye .
owo kalala n efi kwo wu ge wo zhin shekwoyi ikoda nugun nu , n shekwoyi nayi gyi-gyi-yi .
nsayi ye dna n kristi , ala shekwoyi alheri zeya pu eyi alaifi da n yi to kunce lo yagwo kwo gmanyi n amin .
nsayi ye wo tnuyi nge yi lo anyi , yi gna aza vinya n na bai vinya , aɓo ayakwo n shekwoyi ku zhin ɓa nabai ɓa ga gaiciya ɓa vi wo ɓo .
- 7 ofye , anugundo ye-yeyi nfye fi n roma nyi , fye filo n na aza n wo ye , yesu kristi n la fye yi fya ze shekwoyi anya , owo aza gyi-gyi-yi .
shekwoyi sun-sun-gye n bugba fuyi vinya n ɓakun n shekwoyi eyi dada n yesu kristi , eyi dagayi yi aba ɓa ze fye nya .
ma gna fye kmisunyi aba vinya n ma lo , mawo ai dafye gaiciya ga ɓo .
ntuge akpe fye gaiciya ga dna n shekwoyi yelo n anyi vinya .
misa shekwoyi ami dna n yesu kristi n tu nabari manayi ye ɓo , n zaho-zahoi n fye mi .
shekwoyi kpelo shi mi zhin ma zhin aduwa , ntu fye ɓo cici .
nyipyeyi n sukwoyi mi-i ɓe nfyei n fya bukatai , n za aba n mi zhin wo tnu-tnu n mi kalayi vinya , miyi gna aza nabari manayi owo nugun nya .
mi zhin aduwa ma bwa esa n shekwoyi ɓeye nu , ma gye fye njesun , nkwa yezhin omi zan kwa ze lafiya nya .
- 12 ntuge a wo mi pwa ma ɓe fya ba n nabai ma ɓe fye gaiciya ga , n ko ɓa zhi ofye ikklisiya kwa mwa dna n dagayi .
miye fye bmazhin lo ce , ntuge mita ye ma ɓe fye gaiciya ga nu gmanyin , amma ofye nya kwa ɓe mi kala .
zaho-i zahoi n yi mi wa bwa anabarka n na aje aba .
mi n cei pmalo fya kpe omi azaje , nge mi ɓei ku shiri zhin n na bwai mwa-begye ma ɓe fye aba , ( ama to ayen ) n na abai ma zhin tnu-tnu n fye aba omi bwa apma , shi mi zhin n ikklisiya aje .
ntuge mi n ta yakwoyi shi fye lo n azayi vinya , n na zayi n ɓala awye kna n na zayi n awye to kna ɓan , eh , n na ɓeyekpe yi n na azayi n ɓa ta kpe ɓeho yen .
ntu lonu shi mi ɓa mi n sun , mi n mihin yeye yilo ma ɓe f a ba n roma , ma zhin shekwoyi nabari manayi waʼazi .
nabari manayi kristi nya vinyiko ta wo milon , shekwoyi ikoda zokwonu n wo ɓe n na zayi ri shemi n ɓa gwo ko .
aɓei zhin nabari ye waʼazi n kmisun na yahudiyi aba nu , amma n sayiye ala aza vinya yi ɓa ɓe shekwoyi aba n zokwo yeyi .
nabari manayi ye gna yi ge , shekwoyi zhin yi shiri ntu she ɓo , woi zeyi aza manayi n shekwoyi awyeba .
esa n ya ga gaiciya ya kpema yesu wa gniyi , nkwo ya-yai har okwo zo-zo , gaiciya ga nu gakwo .
shi a cei kafi dna n littafi “ oza n wa bwa wye-wyeyi woɓa bwa kwo dna n gaiciya ga n shekwoyi aba nu . ”
amma shekwoyi wu wo minagyi , n kwo gmi n she n na a laifida , n na ɓenukwoyi zhiyi tukwo , aza nukwoyi nɓa ce gaiciya abwa ya ,
gama ɓa kpe shekwoyi gaiciya ga ye lo kwo to ai wu ɓam , shekwoyi la ɓeyekpeye dna ɓa n ɓa bugba mi .
tunyi sapa , aza ɓei ku eshe gye n kniyi n shekwoyi ɓei zhin , ɓai kpege wo lo n iko nyalo-nyalo nyayi .
ntu cenu ɓato naɓezeyi lo lon sanu ɓa ɓei gni agni zhi n shekwoyi abye n wada wyi yin .
e , ɓa kpe owo ɓe yelo , amma ɓato yen , ko ɓa gawo mwa-mwan , ko ɓa zhin wo godiya n tu nwo bmazhin ɓo fyegyi-fyegyin .
safyewyi , ɓaya a nubwozhin abanza nya shi shekwoyi wu , n nyayi nwo ye ɓa zhin .
oɓa bugba tnaceyi kwa ze wyegma kwa ku jeje .
ɓai gyege ɓa ce-cei lo n tna shekwoyi , ɓaku ze aza mama .
nnavun , maimako ɓa ga shekwoyi ikoda nyalo-nyalo mwa-mwa , ɓaku ashinwa , na kutayi ɓa zela ashan ɓa gyiɓa wye , alu , anya fanya , awa n na gbayizanyi-kwo-ciyi .
ntuce nu shekwoyi wa faɓa ɓa zhin anagbayi doho-dohoi nɓa ceyi pma , e , awye bwo ɓo n naɓo nukwoyi ɓai zhin nnajeyi nanyi .
maimakon ɓa ga enya gaiciya , n ɓa kpe ge ko zhin gaiciya nu n shekwoyi tukwo , ɓa kni a nya ɓai gwo kpe , ɓa ga akata gaiciya .
ntu lonu ɓa zhin aduwa ga anya n shekwoyi azhin , amma to ɓa vi n shekwoyi anabarkada ɓo , n wonu na zhin anya vinya nyin .
cenu ɓei zhin shekwoyi wa yaɓa bwa , ɓa zhin aɓo nukwoyi ye vinya .
har oɓa nyikwo ɓa fa zokwo n shekwoyi wa zhin gaɓa , ɓa ce ɓai zhin a nagbayi n na jeyi .
aza nugbayi , maimako ɓa zhin ɓo n kwo kunce n na nyikwozayi , shakpe kwa ɓa duwyi ɓahin-ɓahin , azanugbayi wangye n na jeyi , ntuce nu ɓa gwo ɓa lada dna n ɓa wye-wyeyi , tata n kwo kunce ɓa gwo .
ntu lonu sanu n ɓa ɓei ya shekwoyi bwa to ɓaye a kpewoyen , shekwoyi wa ya ɓa bwa ɓa zhin aɓe awyebwo nya , n ɓa bugba nukwoyi zhin nubwo n cei .
oɓa wye-wyeyi ɓa ku nu n na ɓe nukwoyi n laifiyi , shakpe , n na je bmiyi , eshe , zawu , gusun , akatace , bugba nukwoyi , n na aje ɓedayi .
ɓa ɓei zhin aza ɓetuyi nu , ɓai wun shekwoyi nu , awyegba-ciyi , a tukwo-mwayi , cici ɓai zhin azokwo woi-woyi nubwo shi ɓa ɓa zhin ɓenukwoyi , to ɓai vi oɓa zakwoyi ɓom .
ɓa ta ye awyegan , to ɓai nu alkawali n , n tna ye-ye , n tna sun-sun gye .
ɓa ɓei kpe shekwoyi tata , tu aɓeye tukwo ofi nu , amma ɓa gyi abye n zhin yi har , ɓai dna aza kwoce nge ɓa zhin lonu ce .
to , kpesun , ho cilo ge , ʼaza , ukwoyi nu n na daɓo n ya .
amma lapmi , ho zhin oza laifi da nuce .
sanu n ha ci n cei ge ɓa zhin aza nukwoyi nu , kwoi bmiya lo a gaba tata , ho da hohin tukwo ɓo nu ce , ntuge ho zhin aɓeye lo ce .
yi kpelo ge , shekwoyi ɓei da wa woi zun aza kni n ɓa zhin aɓeye pya .
ho gye ngye shekwoyi ɓei da aza owa , wo la hoi da fwa , hoi zhin aɓoho lo n hohin ?
hota gye lo shi shekwoyi zhin hakuri n hoi m ?
ko ho ta kula lo ma ?
hota gye lon , esaye vinya woi pmi ho to woi tahon , woi gaho sa ha pmi avun wu ho a laifin .
wo wuho alheri deye ntu ge haye abui nu .
amma , fyeta kna tnubua lo n , fye ye minagyi nukwoyi zhi fyehin ntu fye abugba kala kpe ɓo , n ge fyeta pmi avun wu of ye alaifin .
minagyi nyipyei ɓelo n shekwoyi ɓei da anyi vinya wa .
wo ɓei ga oza shi owa tnu-tnu a mu gawo n sun .
wo ɓei ga aza n ɓa zhin shekwoyi ɓeye n hakuri yi , wye-wyei nyalo-nyalo nya , ɓai zan mwa-mwa n latu yi shin n wyewye yi nyalo-nyalo nyai nwo ganyi .
ama wo ɓei ga aza tata n ɓa gni a papa n shekwoyi gaiciya yi , ɓai zan-zan fi n na zokwo nukwoyi , aɓei ze shekwoyi minagyi ya kpe ɓa .
- 10 bugba wun , n na zhingye yi , ɓei bwa a yahudiyi .
na a zayi n ɓato zhin a yahudiyi m vinya , n ɓa gyi abye n ɓenukwoyi zhin yi .
amma aza nɓa vi wo ɓo , ɓa ɓei bwa mwa-mwa n bugba fu yi , ko yahudiyi nu kwo aza nɓato zhin a yahudiyim .
ntuge shekwoyi zhin zaho-zahoyi ɓo n tna awyekwo .
- 15 wo ɓei ta laifi aba n kwo nyi vinya .
wo ɓei ta ashan-gbayi , koda-yake , ɓato n shekwoyi awyidna yi kashi lo n , gama nɓa bugba mi , ɓa kpe ɓe manayi yelo n nukwoyi .
shekwoyi awyidna kafi lo n ɓa bugba mi .
oɓa la-ami kwoi zunɓa kni .
ko kwoyi daɓa wa , shekwoyi ɓei ta a yahudiyi ntu ɓenukwoyi zhin ɓo , ntu ge ɓa n wo awyidna yi ka shi lo , ama to ɓai shi ɓa bwan .
ɓa kpe ɓe manayi ye , ama ɓata zhin kon .
ata ga aza gni-gni n ɓa kpeɓeye n naɓa zhin sai aza n ɓa zhin kwo .
nyipyei ɓelo n shekwoyi ɓei da aza nukwoyi wa , nɓa ɓemwi nukwoyi , dna n yesu kristi .
deye kwonu zhin shekwoyi shiri n mi zhin waʼazi .
ofye a yahudiyi fye zhin nubwo ge ɓeho to dnalo nfye a tasin n shekwoyi n , ntuge wo ɓei ga fye owo wyidna fyei zhin a ɓokwo , fyei gna n ge fye zhin owa nugundo manayi nu .
fye kpeɓeye lo nwo ye , fye kpe ɓe nukwoyi yelo n ɓe manayi fyei gna manayi ye , ntuge aɓe ku wyidna wufye , fyei n na ɓinayi .
fye kpe shekwoyi zokwo ye lo har nfye ɓawu wyebuayi ko n bwanyi yi .
fye gye fyehin nge a fitila nu fyei wu aza zokwo n ɓa fi n wyegma , n ɓata kpe shekwoyi ye n .
fye gye ge fye ɓa mi , fya wu aza n na ɓi yi shekwoyi zokwo , ntu ge fye kpe owo wyidna yelo n ɓa zhin ɓeyekpe n gaiciya yi nyi .
e , fyewu aza knunu zhin , kninu zhin to fyei wu fyehin ma ?
fye gla aza ge ɓato wyivi m , fyehin fyei wyivi ?
fye gna ko to bmiya aza zhin anagbayi n , fyei zhin n fyehin ?
fye gna ato gba ashan fyei ze agyiwye efye shekwoyi .
fye zhin aɓekwo n ge fyekpe shekwoyi awyidna ye , ama fyei dnawo vinyikwo to fyei shi ɓa bwan .
gaiciya nu n littafi a da , nge anyi da ɓeda nukwoyi n shekwoyi tukwo n tu n fye ɓo .
ayi oza ye yahudiyi nu kwo zhin ɓe manayi nu , n ho shi wo awyidna bwa .
ama n ho to shi ɓa bwan , ho to du aɓe nukwoyi zhinyi lo n .
( atna-kaciya zhinyi ) .
ndei a shangbayi shi shekwoyi awyidna bwa , shekwoyi ta gaɓa mwa-mwa n yanci yi , n wa zhin shiri ge wa ga a yahudiyi nyi n ?
ɓehin-hin ashan-gbayi ɓoku dufye a yahudiyi , n fye kpe shekwoyi ɓeye n mwanyi , n wo alkawali yi shinyi , to fyei shi owa wyidna bwanyin .
fye to zhin a yahudiyi hin-hin nu shifye azakwoyi zhin a yahudiyin , kwo kuwa shifye zhin kaciyan .
aʼa , oza n wo bugba wulo cewo n shekwoyi aba , wonu zhin yahudiyi hin-hin .
ntuge shewoyi ta dna aza wye nu n ɓa sa ɓa nayi yan n kaciya zokwon , ama wo dna ozanu wye n wo bugba manayi .
oza n wo bugba do shanye kpe n wo wye-wyei mi wo ɓa bwa latu n shekwoyi abanu , to ge n fye abam .
mi gye ampanyi nza zhin yahudiyi nyi ?
gyiba manayi ho lo n shekwoyi aba ?
ampanyi ho lo n na yahudiyi kaciya n ɓa zhin nyi ?
e , ampanyi lo n oza ɓa n wo zhin yahudiyi , kmisunyi shekwoyi ɓei gaɓa owo awyidna .
( n nabai ɓa kpe , ɓa zhin wo ɓeye ) .
gaiciya azaho n ɓa mi to ɓei n aminci yi n , ntuge ɓa ɓei bma alkawali ya n shekwoyi yi , kwa wu nu ge shekwoyi ɓa bma wo alkawaliya ?
aʼa , ko shi kwo nyi aza vinya n na anyi zhin aza kata nu , shekwoyi to zhin zakatan nun .
ho pa enya lo n litafi n zaburada n deye tukwo ?
shekwoyi ɓeda ta shan don , ci-ci kwo zhin gaiciya nu .
ko nyikadonu nu na nya ɓa ɓo .
ama , azaho ci ge , owo ɓeda n yi to shi bwa nyi n , kwo n na ampanyi yilo , eyi alaifi ku ampanyi zhin , ntu ge aza ɓa gye shi shekwoyi yeye nyi , esa ɓa gye shi yi zhin aɓe nukwoyi zan .
kwo bmiya lo n wo aba wa tayi , esa ya zhin ɓe nikwoyi , eyi alaifi yi bwa wo go bmazhin ?
shekwo sauka .
kni shekwoyi pya nu to woi ta laifin ma ?
wo ɓa zun oza kni n wu na ?
ntuge wota mi wa da mi owa , wa zunmi kni ngye laifi da n , ndei omi tna gaiciya ɓe wolo n mwa-mwayi koi wuge wo zhin gaiciya da nun .
n ha vi kwo lo nu , ha gye shi yi gna ɓenukwoyi zhin nu dudu .
shekwoyi wa gna kwo ye .
amma aza n ɓa da abeye pya knizun kunce lo n ɓa aba .
dudu lonu aza ho gye ge nya nu n mi zhin waʼazi .
to , eyi a yahudiyi du aza je lo ?
ko fyewyi , ntuge , yi ku luwu ge aza vinya zhin a laifi danu .
ko a yahudiyi ko aza nɓa to zhin a yahjudiyin .
she littafi a da , za manayi to lo n , zaknayi to lon nna nyimi n wo to zhin laifi danu n .
ozato lo n wo vi shekwoyi zokwo cewo ko n wo n cei pma wa vin .
zaho-zahoi la wonya pmiya , aza vinya nku ɓenukwoyi zhin , oza to lo n bwaho n wo zhin ɓe manayi ko zaknayin .
oɓa ɓeda tucegye , n ce asin ngye vingwo nkwo gu-guyi ya gni .
oɓa nyitala nu-nuyi n na katayi .
ɓeda doho-dohoyi nɓa da kwo n mwi nukwoyi fi , n kwo ɓa wu oza .
oɓa gbe , nu-nuyi n na aknikpe yi n minagyi yi .
ba pye-pyeyi n za wu , ɓai wun za nu n wo to gwo ɓa ɓedan .
abaho-bahoi n ɓa lo ɓa fa bugba wun n wahala yi n na azhingye yi .
ɓa ta kpe enya ye n na yi ge , bugba fun kwo shekwoyi anabarka m .
ɓa ta gye ɓa nuwan n shekwoyi , kwo enya n wo zhin nubo n ɓa tukwon .
ntucenu shekwoyi minagyi n wagyi tulo mwa n na yahudiyi , ntu ge oɓa tnu-tnu nu , ɓa shi shekwoyi awyidna bwa , ɓace ɓai zhin aɓo nukwoyi , zaknayi n ɓami to n na ɓenayi lo lon .
ɓehin-hin anyi vinya to n na gmiba yi lon n shekwoyi ikoda abyen .
nsayi ye , hoku gye ?
za to lo n naɓa zewo oza manayi n shekwoyi abam , ntuge wo zhin ɓo n na awyid-na da m .
ntuge yi kpe shekwoyi awyidnaye , ya gye to yi gna ɓa bwa shin , owo awyidna wu yi ge , yi zhin aɓe nukwoyi zhin yi nu .
- 23 amma nsayiye shekwoyi ku eshe zokwo do wuyi , gbo , n na wyidna bwashi yi , amma n zokwo woyi ( ko-daya-ke zokwo woyi nu to n , ntu ge shekwoyi ɓeda ku gna yi tunyi n sapa ) .
nsaiye shekwoyi wa gna ge woɓa gwo yi , wa zeyi a tna laifi da .
n ya kpema yesu kristi wa zo yi a laifi , wa zhin yi gafara .
aɓa gni yi n zokwo deye n ya ɓe kristi aba .
ko hoi zhin nyika donuʼa , ko hoya zhin kni laifi nuʼa .
aza vinya nku laifi zhin ɓai ku gba kpekpe-gye n shekwoyi mwa-mwa aba ,
ama nsayi yi ku ze aza akni-kni-yi , ntu wo alheli ɓo , nɓa ɓe dna n gni-gni n yesu kristi aba nyi .
shekwoyi wa tnu n yesu yi ntu ge , wa ze doshan nya nya ntu oyi alaifi ɓo , ozaho-zahoi nwa ga gaiciya aku gafara zhin wo .
shekwoyi wa shin deye ntu ge wa wu ge wo zhin ɓefyecei nu , nsa avun nya , wo ɓei la bugba bwa n laifi-i , to wa ga aza ta-ta m
wa zhin deye nsayi ye ntu ge , wa wu ge wo zhin oza kni-kni-yi nu , woi ɓa mi wa gmi oza ya tu nwa ga yesu gaiciya , wohin ce wa ze oza kni-kni-yi .
nyaho lo n zanyikwoci ɓa mwa wohin nkwo ɓo ?
nge awo .
ntu kniɓehia ?
ntu ge yi shi awyidna bwa ?
awo , ama ntu gaiciya ga ɓo .
onya gmanyi nu n yi kpe lo , okwo nu ge a ta bwa gni-gni n awyidna bwashi ɓo nu m , ama n gaiciya ga aba .
mi nya ge , shekwoyi zhin ayahudiyi shekwoyi nu gmanyi , wo to zhin abyedo shekwoyi nu ce n ?
cewo wo zhin ɓa nya nu .
shekwoyi gmanyi nu , owo nu ɓa gni ayahudiyi ntu ɓa gaiciya ga ɓo , owo nu-i ɓa gni abyedo , ntu ba gaiciya ga ɓo .
shi kwo wu lo nu nyi , ta gye yi ɓa ku awyidna ze gboloyi n ?
nge awo , awyidna ze gboloyi n ?
nge awo , awyidna nɓa apmayi lo .
- 2 dna n nayi ibrahim nu zhin eyi a yahu-diyi dada .
ko ɓei wo n wuna dna nɓenya yemiʼa , gaiciya ga n gni-gni yiʼa ?
ntu nwo atnu-tnu manayi ɓo nu n shekwoyi ɓei gwo wo ?
ngye lonu nu , yi n nyai lo n yi ɓa gma .
ama n shekwoyi aba ibrahim to n na abayi lo n wo ɓa gma kwo wa zhin aɓekwo n .
ntuge , littafi ku gna yi ge ibrahim ɓei ga shekwoyi gaiciya , ntuce nu shekwoyi wa zo wo alaifi wa yi wo oza gyi-gyi-yi .
- 5 ama wo to ɓei lo eshe ntu n wa aɓo amanayi ɓo nu n wo ɓei zhin nyin ?
awo , gni-gni zhin shekwoyi cauta nu .
aga aza nu n ɓa to zhin tnu-tnu n tu nkwo ɓo n .
ntuge shekwoyi ze alaifi da a gyi-gyi-yi n wo awyeba , ɓai ya ga kristi gaiciya , wa gni ɓa n shekwoyi minagyi .
dawuda esuɓei ku oza agmada ɓeda wato laifida n shekwoyi la wo ze oza gyi-gyi-yi ntna laifi nwo abye .
anabarka da nu oza n shekwoyi ku gafara zhin wo , wo la oza laifi kuya n wo awye ba .
e , agmada yakwo nu n za aba n na aku abui zowo , to dagayi shan wo alaifi ba m .
nsaiye ɓonya nyi ge ; aga aza nu anabarka n ɓa ga kristi gaiciya ɓai shi a yahudiyi awyidna bwa , ko aga aza nu anabarka n ɓata shi a yahudiyi awyi-dna bwan , amma ɓai kpe ma kristi a ?
ibrahim ma , n ya gna ge wo ɓei gwo anabarka ntu wo gaiciya gaɓonu .
gaiciya ga nu gmanyi ?
ko ntu ge wo ɓei shi a yahudiyi awyidna bwa nuʼa ?
ntu ge aga ɓonya deye amsa , sai a ga deye amsa kpa .
shekwoyi ɓei ga ibrahim owo anabarka n kni sayiʼa ?
tun kafin wo ze yahudiyi , kalm wo zhin kaciya .
nna avun nu n shekwoyi ɓei zhin wo alkawali ntu n wo gaiciya ga ɓo , a zhin wo kaciya .
kaciya zhin ɓei wuge ibrahim n gaiciya ga yi lo , njesun ge shekwoyi ɓei lawo lu gwo wa zewo tna-laifi da , oza manayi nwo awyeba kafin a zhin wo kaciya .
ntu lo nu ibrahim nu zhin dada , zafun nya , n aza aba nɓa ku gaiciya ga , ai la ɓa gni to ɓai shi yahudiyi awyidna bwan .
yi ku gye nu aza nɓa ta shi awyidna bwan , shekwoyi nu gniɓa ntu ɓa gaiciya ɓo .
ibrahim nu zhin a yahudiyi dada dna n zafun n na ku kaciya zhin ɓa .
ɓa ɓa gye n wo ɓesisi nge kaciya zhin nu tagni ɓa m , ntu ge ibrahim ɓei bwa shekwoyi alheri ntu wo gaiciya ga ɓonu gmanyi , kafin azhin wo kaciya .
kwa wunu cewo ngye shekwoyi alkawali , nwo ɓei zhin ibrahim nwo byei nyi , nge wo ɓa gawo anyi vinya nyi .
woto ɓei zhin wo alkawali ye ntu ge wo ɓei shi shekwoyi awyidna bwa nun , ama ntuge wo ɓei ga wo gaiciya .
ntuce nu n dei hoye gnalo ge shekwoyi anabarka lo aza banu n ɓa zhin ɓemana , ho gna nu ge , shekwoyi alkawali n na a gaiciya gayi aba kwo zhin gbeloyi nu , gaiciya ga n la ze nyaze .
ama gaiciya ɓeda ye nya nu nyi .
sa nu n ya zhin atna ge ya bwa shekwoyi anabarka n gni-gni yi , n na ɓemanayi zhin ɓo , n wo awyidna bwa shi yi , yi zhin ya zo fi n wo minagyi nu , ntuge ci-ci yi ta mi nɓa bwa shin .
zokwo gmanyi n yi ɓa fa awyidna bmaya ɓo , yito bwa wyidna kwo gmanyin .
ntu lonu , agayi shekwoyi anabarka ntu gaiciya ga ɓo nu .
cauta nu yi ɓa gwo kwo to yi ya vi a yahudiyi kunun , n yi n gaiciya gayi lo ngye ibrahim .
ntuge ibrahim nu zhin yi dada sa n kwa ɓe gaiciya ga aba .
nya nu n littafi a da , sa n kwo ciyi ge shekwoyi ɓei la ibrahim ze oda aza begye nya .
shekwoyi ɓa gwo aza vinya n ɓa ga shekwoyi gaiciya shi ibrahim ɓei zhin nyi .
alkawali deye gmi n shekwoyi aba nu , n wo zhin a zafi ɓai bwa wye-wyeyi n jesun nyi , woi da aɓo ɓo n ɓa ɓei zhin n abye n gyeɓaku luzhin .
ntu lo nu , sa n shekwoyi ɓei gna ibrahim nge , wo ɓa gawo ɓi n wo ɓa bwa ebye gawo n mwa , waze ebye yakwo , ibrahim ʼbei la shekwoyi ga gaciya ko shi ko nyi kwo ɓei zhin ɓo ɓedna yi nu .
ntuge , owo gaiciya ga ɓei n kalayi , wo to ɓei damu ge wola kwo n , nna ɓa yi wo ge oda nyin .
woi aye yi tagyi , saratu owo nyikwo aye ce shi-ciwa-gmanyi , wo ɓei la du aɓima saya .
ama ibrahim to ɓei zhin shekwoyi shakan , wa ga shekwoyi gaiciya ntuge , owo gaiciya ga nwo awyetu yi ɓei n kalayi .
wa ci shekwoyi ntu anabarka ye ɓo , to woi lu ɓa bwan .
wo ɓei n gaiciyai ga ge shekwoyi ɓa mi wa nu ɓo n wa da .
ntu ibrahim gaiciya ga ɓo , shekwoyi wa zhin wo alaifi gafara , wa ze oza ntna laifi .
nsaiye , ɓeda wo-wo yi ye nge aɓei gwo wo ntu nwo gaiciya ga ɓo nu , ko to ɓei zhin ntu ibrahim gyi ba ɓo nu gmanyin .
kwo zhin eyi nyanu , kwo wuyi ge shekwoyi ɓa gwo yi n zokwo gmanyi , shi wo ɓei gwo ibrahim nyi – sanu n ya ga shekwoyi alkawali gaiciya , n wo ɓei la yesu eyi dagayi kala n efi nyi .
wo ɓei fi ntu yi alaifi ɓo wa laka n vingwo ntu ge wa ze yi aza ye-ye yi n shekwoyi aba .
woi nu yi n shekwoyi ɓe manayi .
ntu lonu , nsayi ye shi aku yi ze abefyecezhin yi n shekwoyi abye nyi , ntu yi gaiciya ga ɓo n wo alkawali .
yi ɓa bwa bugba fu hin-hin nsaiyi ntu n ɓo n yesu kristi eyi dagayi ku zhin ga yi nyi .
ntuge , ntu n yi gaiciya ga ɓo nu n wa ɓe n yi n aba n yi gni-agni zhin n saiye nyi .
yi n bugba kalayi n agmadayi , yi shiwye ya ze enya n shekwoyi n ceyi dna n bugba ntu yi ɓo ya ze .
yi ɓa dagma ce sanu n ya lo wahala ncei , ntu ge yi kpe ge ko n na pmayi lo-lo n yi aba , ɓa wu yi shi yi ɓa zhin hankuri .
hankuri zhin kwa ɓe n kala yi kwa bma yi zhin ya kpema shekwoyi esayi vinya , ya zhin apma n kwoi har esa n yi awyetu n gaiciya gai ɓa bwa kala n mi gni yi .
nnavun , sanu n kwo zhin lonu , yiɓa mi ya bwa bugba kala ko knidonu na zhin yiʼa , yi kpe ge nyaho ta zhin ntuge yi kpelo shi shekwoyi yeyi , yi wo ye-ye yi lo n yi abugba mi , ntuge shekwoyi zafun dnalo n yi mi , woi nuyi a bugba n wo yeye yi .
sanu n yi to ɓei n bmazhin yi , n tna gni-gni zokwo , yesu wa ɓedna n sai dai-dai wafi ntu n yi alaifi ɓo , eyi n yi to ɓei n na pmayin .
ko yi n na pmayi , yi to ɓei dnace nge ozaho ɓa fi n yi ɓon , ko shiko nyi kpekni ko ɓei ɓa yezhin lonu .
ama , shekwoyi wa wuyi owo yeye shiwa tnu n kristi yi , wa fi tu n yi ɓo , tunyi yi ye zhin a laifi da .
shi kwo nyi nwo ami yi nu , nwa zhin aɓedeye gayi , yi ye zhin alaifi da , ai , woɓa gna zhin-zhin gayi nu n sayi , shi wo layi gni nyi .
nsayi wo ɓa gni yi n shekwoyi minagyi vinya n kwo ɓelo nyi .
tunyi , yi ye zhin wo anuɓayi , a jeze ɓe n yi n shekwoyi aba , ntu n wo nugun efi ɓo .
anabarka yakwo nu , n yi ɓa gna bwa n sayi n yi ku zhin wo anugundo nyi , woi dna lo n yi mi .
nsayi ye , yi dagma ntu jedoɓe woi-woi ɓo n shekwoyi , ntu nya ɓo n yi dagayi yesu kristi wa zhin gayi , nwa fi ntu yi alaifi ɓo nyi , woi zeyi shekwoyi a nugundo .
sanu adamu ɓei zhin laifi , ɓenukwoyi zhin a lo anyi vinya .
owo laifi kwoi gna efi laɓa n na anyi vinya , ntucenu anya vinya ɓai kwo , ɓai fi , ntuge aza vinya n ku laifi zhin .
yi kpelo ge adamu laifi nu na ɓe nɓe deye yi , ntuge kodayake , aza ɓei zhin ɓai zhin benukwoyi tun adamu sa , har musasa , shekwoyi to ɓei zhin woi daɓa ofi wa ntuge ɓa bma wo a wyidna yan , gama woto ɓei gaɓa owo awyidnan , kwo wo gna ɓa enya n wo ye ɓa zhin .
ntu lonu sanu n ɓa nayi ɓei zhin kwoi fi , kwo to ɓei fi ntu n ɓa laifi ɓo nun , ntuge , ɓa to ɓei zun shekwoyi owa gna , shi adamu ɓei zhin nyi m .
dogbe lo n adamu a tasin n kristi yi n wo to ɓei lu ɓe nyin .
doshan lo dna oza laifi n shekwoyi gafara zhin yi .
ntuge zaknayi ye , adamu ɓei ɓe aza mwa begye n fiyi ntu nwo laifi ɓo , ama zaknayi ye , yesu kristi woi ɓe aza n mwa begye a gafara zhinyi dna n shekwoyi sun-sun-gye .
adamu laifi gmanyi ɓei ɓe aza nfi lada yin n mwa .
ama kristi woi ku alaifi n mwa woi ga wye-wyeyi manayi nfi aba .
zaknayi laifi adamu , kwo la zhin esu tu n na aza tukwo vinya , ama oza n wa gwo shekwoyi cauta , gafara zhin n lo-lo , ɓaku zhin wye-wyeyi asu ntu zaknanyi ɓo , yesu kristi .
e , adamu laifi ɓei ɓe n tata yi n na aza tukwo vinya , ama kristi ɓe manayi zhin kwa ze aza aɓe-fyece zhinyi n shekwoyi abye , n na bai ɓa pwo .
adamu wa zhin aza n mwa begye , ɓa ze alaifi da , ɓai zun shekwoyi ɓeda gna , ama kristi wa zhin shekwoyi woi gwo aza n mwa begye ntuge wo ɓei vi ɓo .
aɓei ga awyidna ngun awo , n nabai zahozahoi wa gye aba nwa kaya n shekwoyi awyidna bwashi .
ama , sanu ya gye eyi alaifi , ya gye shekwoyi alheri dna ngafara zhin mi n mwa .
nsapai , laifi ɓei gyi ʼbe tu n aza tukwo vinya kwoi ɓe n ɓai nfi , ama nsayi ye shekwoyi alheri nu gyi be , kwoi gayi a gni-gni manayi n shekwoyi abye , n wye-wyeyi nyalo-nyalo nyayi n yesu kristi eyi dagayi .
to , yi ɓa gyi abye n ɓenukwoyi zhin yi , n nabai shekwoyi wa gyi abye n yi alheri wuyi n gafara zhin yi ?
- 3 awo , yiɓa gyi abye n laifi zhinyi to kwoi zhin dole nu ?
ntuge aɓei la laifi iko bmaya n yi tukwo , sanu n yi ɓe ze a yesu viyi nyi , a zhin yi baptisma ya ze gmanyi n yesu yi , ntu nwo efi ɓo , aɓei la ofye nanyi laifi zhin nya iko bmaya .
aɓei la of ye nayi laifi nya bi dna n baptisma sanu n woi ɓei fi , sanu dada shekwoyi n wo iko dnagmayi , ɓei jeze ɓe n yesu yi n wye-wyeyi n efi , aɓei la owo wye-wyeyi woi-woyi ga yi ya dagma .
ntuge fyeku ze nayi gmanyi n woi , ntu cenu fyeku fi n woi sanu n wo ɓei fi nyi , nsayi wo ga fye owo wye-wyei woi-woyi , fye ɓei kukala evingwo shi wo ɓei lakala .
aɓei la ofye a shakpe nukwoyi zundu n gnisun n woi , ofye nayi n kwo ye laifi nyi , aɓei lakwo gwoya a tu kwo eci nukwoyi n nabai ofye laifi nayi to kwo shan dna n laifi sirtan , to kwa ze laifi baran .
sanu , nfye ku fi n laifi aba fyeku pwo nkwo kwocedna n kwo ikoyi nfye tukwo .
tunda of ye nanyi kwo-kwoyi laifi ye nya ɓei lafi n yesu yi , yi kpelo ge wo ɓa gayi owo wyewyeyi .
kristi la laka n vingwo wo ta shan fi n jesun , efi to n iko dohoi shan sun lo n wo tukwon .
wo ɓei fi bwazun gmanyi wa zo laifi iko , ama n sayiye wo n vrye-wyei lo n sase n shekwoyi nyalo-nyalo .
ntu lonu fye ze of yehin aza fi-fiyi n laifi aba , to fya ye laifi ayin fya ku ze awye-wyei da n shekwoyi aba fyei wo-wo dna n yesu kristi eyi dagayi .
fyeto ye laifi kwa bwa iko tu nfye nanyi tukwo n shan sun , fye to ye okwo ashakpe nukwoyi n .
fye to ye ega doho nfye nanyi kwa ze ɓenukwoyi zhin nyan , kwa ze laifi zhinya , ama fye ga fyehin tukwo vinya n shekwoyi akun nfye aga yi vinya , ntu ge fye la kun n efi , fye ku ze apmanya n shekwoyi akun , wa zhin apma n fyei n wo ɓeye gmanyi .
laifi to shan fye tukwo da zen , ntuge fye to ye filo n ewa suntan , aba n laifi ɓa zefye owo baran .
ai fye n yanci yi lo dna n shekwoyi alheri n sun-sun gyei .
kwo wunu ge yi ɓa gyi abye n ɓenukwoyi zhin yi to ya gye yi anuwan n kwo ɓeyin ?
( ntuge eyi gni-gni to lo n ge sai ya shi awyidna bwanun , ama shekwoyi alheri nu ) , awo .
fye ta kpe lon nge fye ɓa mi fya kni fye dagayin ?
fye ɓa mi fya kni laifi ( n fiyi ) ko , ɓovi ( n gyi-gyi-yi ) oza nfya ga fyehin tukwo n wo a kun wonu ɓa lafye wa ze of ye dagayi fya zewo afyenu .
fye gode n shekwoyi , ntu ge fye ɓei zhin laifi abara nu , nsaiye fyeku ɓovi n fye abugbayi vinya , enya n shekwoyi wa wufye .
nsayi ye , fyela kun n ifye dagayi kwo-kwoyi akun , laifi , fyei ku ze ofye dagayi woi-woyi abara , ɓefyece .
mi daɓo n layi mi-i zhin apma n ɓesisi abara nya n na dagayi nyayi , ntuge fya bwa awyega n pye .
shi fye ɓei zhin abara laifi gbo-gbo nya nyi , ntu lonu , nsaiye fye fa fyehin fya ze abara aɓe manayi nya nɓeyi vinya n kwo gyi-gyi-yi .
nsapai n fye ɓei zhin laifi bara , fye to ɓei gye fye anuwan n ɓe manayi zhin yin .
fya bwa kni gyiba yiʼa ?
gyiba to ɓei bmiyam , tunda vinyikwo wo fyelo fyei ya zhin aɓo nubo n fyeɓei zhin fyei zhin nyi .
ntuge aɓeye zofi n anapi nu n shekwoyi minagyi yi .
ama n sayi ye fye la kun n laifi iko , fye ku zhin shekwoyi abara , owo gyiba nwo ga fye okwo nu gyi-gyi n wye-wyeyi nyalo-nyalo nya yi .
gama laifi lada ofi nu , amma shekwoyi cauta wye-wyei nyalo-nyalo nya nu dna n yesu kristi eyi dagayi .
fye ta kpelon omi azaje aye-yei , a yahudiyi dna n kristi sanu n oza lafi owa to n iko yi shan sun lo n wo aban ?
ma ga ɓesisi ; sanu nyikoza pamula owa n lawo pa gyi nwo ɓa har ewyi n wa fi ncei .
ama n wa fi owa to n ikoyi shan sun lo n wo tukwon .
mula owa ta shan wo knizun .
nsayi , woɓa mi wa se enu do , n wa ye kwo ɓei ɓa zhin nukwoyi owo ɓa wo n wye-wyei , ama , kwo to zhin nukwoyi nu woi la fin .
ofye ɓa , ofye tukwo da kwo nu ɓei zhin owa a yahudiyi nya , ama , fya ku fi n kristi yi n zundu , tunda fye ku fi , fye to ye shan owa se lon , kohin to n ikoyi shan sun lo n fye tukwon .
fye a jeze ɓe wye-wyei sa n kristi a laka n vingwo fyei ku ze aza woi-woyi nsaiye , fye ku se oza nwa laka la n efi n nabai fya zhin a tnu-tnu a manayi , a tnu-tnu amanayi shekwoyi nya .
sanu , n oza kwo-kwoyi ɓei zhin woi ye lo tnu-tnu n fye mi aɓo nukwoyi zhin pwa ɓei zhin ɓai wo fye , fyei zhin oɓo n shekwoyi a gna nge fye to zhin , fyei zhin aɓo anukwoyi a tnu-tnu efi nya .
ama nsaiye fye to gye fye anuwan n na yahudiyi owa yin n ɓa knunu yin .
ntuge fyeɓo ku fi , fyei fi n ɓa bauta zhin , nsaiye , fye ɓa zhin shekwoyi bauta to ge dna n zokwo kwo-kwoyi , fyei shi awyidna bwan , ama n zokwo woyi , ( nfye abugbai vinya n fye awye-wyei vinya . )
to , mi wu nu nge shekwoyi owa zhin nukwoi nu ?
awo , owa to zhin nyanukwoyi nun , owa nu ɓei wumi omi laifi , mi to ɓei ɓa kpe laifi ye n kwo dna n mi bugban , aɓo pwa wo nukwoi n ɓa ɓe fi n mi bugba min , to owai a gna n ge , “ to wo aɓo nukwoi shakpe n ho bugba min . ”
ama , laifi zhin a pma n owa yi , kwoi wumi nge shakpe deye pya to bmiyam , kwoi ku anya pwawo nukwoi kala n mi-mi .
to owa ɓei lo n na ɓa zun gnana , to ɓenukwoyi zhin yi yelon .
cenu ɓei zhin to ma gye mi anuwan sanu n mi to ɓei kpe nya ye n owa yen .
ama sa n mi ɓei kpe gaiciya ye , ma kpe ge mi la owa zungna , mi la ze laifi da n kunce n fiyi .
nmi aba , manayi n kwo ɓei kunce kwa wu mi wye-wyei zokwo , kwo nu a zhin a gami efi lada nu .
laifi ɓei dna mi kwoce kwoi la owa manayi shekwoyi nya kwoi zhin apma n kwoi , kwoi zemi oza n wo kunce n ofi yi .
ama owa n kwohin tukwo kwo zhin nya manayi nu n bmiya .
ama kwo ɓa ze nwuna ?
owa nu to bwi min ?
kwo ɓa ze manayi n wuna ?
awo , laifi nu .
nya kasa – nu ɓei zhin apma n nyai n kwo bmiya , kwa zun mi kni ntu lonu fye gye , kwo zhin nya kasa nya nukwoyi .
ntu ge kwo zhin apma n shekwoyi owa manayi kwa nu kwo ɓeye .
ntu lonu owa bmiya , wahala to !
lo n kwoi nun , ama n mihin nu , ntuge mi kundna gni nu nbauta zhin , n laifi yi n ze omi tukwoda .
mi ta kpe , omihin tukwo ɓe ganyi lon , ntuge , mi ye ma zhin oɓo n kwo bmiya , ama mi ta min .
mi zhin oɓo n mi to cei pman , enya n mi ta yen .
mi kpelo sarai enya n mi zhin nyi kwo to bmiya lon , emi nubo zhin wumi nge , mila ye n owa yei n mi zungna nyi .
ama mi ta mi ma bma mihin zhin , ntuge mi to ye zhin celon , laifi nu n kwo dna n mi , n du mi kala nyi , kwoi zhin mi mi-i zhin aɓo a nukwoyi .
mi kpelo nge mi la bwo n mi nai kwo-kwoyi , kwo n miya pmi lo n kni bwai nuʼa , mi ta mi ma zhin mihin ma zhin ɓe manan , mi n cei pmalo ama mita min .
sa n mi cei pma ma zhin ɓe manayi , mi ta min , n ma zhin atna to ma zhin ɓenukwoyin , ma zhin kwonu .
ama ngye mi zhin ɓo lo n mi to n cei pman , kwo wunu ge laifi ye n mii shilo n kwo akun .
kwa wunu ge owa ye zhin tnutnu lo n mi , sanu n mi cei pma ma zhin oɓo n kwo bmiya ma ze ma zhin nukwoyi nu .
miye ma zhin shekwoyi ɓeye , shi emi zawoi-woi ncei pma .
- 24 ama nyalo n dna n mi mi , n mi oza kninya kwoi sun kun lo nmi-i , kwoi gyi nasara n mi-i , kwoi zemi laifi bara n kwo ye dnalo n mi .
nmi mi , mi cei pma ma ze bara shekwoyi ɓeye zhin yi .
ama ma gye mi ye zhin laifi bauta .
omi za woi-woi gnami ge mi zhin ɓe manayi , ama oza kwo-kwoyi nkwo dna nmi mi n cei pmalo kwa zhin ɓenukwoyi .
ewuyi emi , mi la ze sun-sun nya .
nyi kadonu ɓa gni mi n nai efi nya yeʼa ?
ma gode n shekwoyi , yesu kristi eyi dagayi n lami gni woi la mi loya .
ntu cenu , knizun to lo nna aza ba , n ɓa zhin kristi yesu nya n .
ntuge iko zafun wye-wyei ga nyaiko ye zhin mi nya nu dna kristi yesu-kwo la mi loya n laifi awun n ofiyi .
ato gni yi , n laifi akun ntuge yi kpe shekwoyi awyidna ye lo nun , ntuge yita mi n ɓa kni ya shi bwan , ama shekwoyi wa zhin zokwo do wa gni yi , wa tnu n wo nugun yi dna n zanyikwoci nayi ngye eyi nya , ama eyi anya n laifi yi wa wun laifi iko ya n yi tukwo .
wa ga wohin tukwo hadaya ntu yi alaifi ɓo .
ntu cenu , nsaiye yi ɓa mi ya vi shekwoyi awyidna n ya vi zafun gyi-gyi-yi , to ya vi nayi kwo-kwoi n kwo dna n yi nyin .
aza nɓa fa oɓa nayi kwo-kwoi kwoi bwa iko tu n ɓa tukwo , ɓa vi ɓahin ɓeye nu .
ama aza n ɓa vi zafun gyi-gyi-yi , ɓa nu zhin oɓo n kwo da shekwoyi .
oza n wo vi zafun ɓeye wo ɓa bwa wye-wyeyi n bugba-fuyi .
ama oza nu wa vi nayi wo ɓa fi .
ntuge eyi oza kwo-kwoyi n kwo dna yi nyi kwo zhin nuɓayi nu n shekwoyi , kwo ta ye kwa shi shekwoyi awyidna bwan , kwoi ta min .
cenu zhin , aza n ɓa fi n ɓa nayi kwo-kwoyi iko sinta ɓai vi oɓa aɓo fawo n shakpe nukwoyi , ɓa ta mi ɓa zhin ɓo n kwo da shekwoyin .
ama fyeto wu lo nun oza woi-woi nu zhin iko n fyei , ngye fye , n shekwoyi zafun yi lo n dna n fye mi , ( fya pa oza n wo to n kristi zafun yi dnalo n wo min , wo to zhin kristi viyi nun kwo fyewyi . )
ko idayake kristi dnalo n mi ofya nayi ɓa fi ntu n laifi ɓo , ama of ya wyewyeyi ɓa pwo ntuge kristi nku gafara zhin fye .
ndei shekwoyi zafun nwa la yesu kala n efi nyi , n dnalo n fyemi wo ɓa zhin ofye a nayi fifiyi , ɓa bwa wye-wyei nfye efi avun , ntu n zafun ye ɓo n wo dna n fye nyi .
ntu cenu , omi azaje yeyeyi kwo to zhin tilas nu nge fya vi ofye za kwo-kwoi ɓo fya zhin ɓo nwa gna fyem .
ntuge n fya vi kwo fye ku bwi , aɓa ta fye , ama dna n zafun gyi-gyi-yi iko fya ɓakwoya n kwa ɓenukwoi zhin yi fye ɓa pwo .
aza vinya n shekwoyi zafun wu ɓa zokwo ɓanu zhin shekwoyi aɓi .
nlonu yi to ze ngye afyenu , yi wo dna n , ama yi zhin aɓo n gye shekwoyi aɓi nwa gwo ɓa fi n wo iyali ɓai yiwo “ dada , dada ” .
ntuge owo zafun gyi-gyi-yi daɓo n yi n ya bugba mi n ge yi zhin shekwoyi aɓi nu .
shi yi zhin owo aɓi nu nyi , yi ɓei gyiwo gado – ntuge nya n shekwoyi gawo nugun yesu kwo zhin eyi nyanu ce .
ama n yi ye owo mwa-mwa tilas ya gye azhin nkunsun nwoi .
wahala n yi sin n saiye nyi kwo to kunce lo a mwi kwo do n mwa-mwai n wo ɓei gayi nyin .
ntuge shekwoyi anya zhin-zhin vinya zhi ɓai pmi nu , n hakuriyi , n awyetu yi nyipyei n shekwoyi ɓei ku owo aɓi kala n fi .
- 21 ntuge dna nyipyei hi , akna wuyi atakanda , laifi , efi , nbwo-bwoyi – anya vinya nɓa gyi nasara tu n na anyi tukwo to n kwo ɓeyei dna n shekwoyi gbe ga – ɓa ɓei ku bwiwye - anyi vinya ɓei gwo mwa-mwa ɓai bwa loloya n laifi , n shekwoyi aɓi bwa kwo agmada nyi .
ntuge yi kpelo anya-zhin-zhin ngye anya-fanya n agbe-gbei na shinwa yi ɓa bwa nyasan ɓai fi nge ɓa pmi nyipyei ye .
eyihin a yesu viyi ko shiko nyi yi n zafun gyi-gyi-yi dna lo n yi mi ngye tuze eyi mwamwa nya , yi do dna n yi wye-wyei mi , a lo yi ya n na azhin-gye n wahala yi , yihin ce yi pmi nyipyei , wyi n shekwoyi ɓei gayi eyi loloya towo aɓi nya ɓedo n nayi woi-woyi n wa zhin yi alkawali nyi , anayi n nyasan ta shan ɓa san , ɓai ta shan fin .
a gniyi n gaiciya ga mi nu , gaiciya zhin awyetu nya n yi to ncei lo nsayi yen .
oza n wo n nyayi wota shan awye tun , waga gaiciya nge wo ɓa bwa kwon .
ama ndei yi ga shekwoyi gaiciya n nya tukwo n kwoto zhin , kwo wu yi nge yi pmi n hankuri yi n bugba kalai .
dna n zokwo gmanyi zafun gyi-gyi-yi bmayi zhin n yi aɓesa yi fyegyi-fyegyi dna n yi aduwa zhin mi .
ntuge yi ta kpe nya ye lo n yi ɓa zhin aduwa n kwo tukwon , kwo n yi ɓa zhin cewon .
ama zafun gyi-gyi-yi zhin aduwa n tu yiɓo n bugba shanwo yi n na ta mi ada n gbeyi m .
eyi dada , n wo kpe eyi abugba ye n yi , wo kpe nya ye n zafun da , sanu nwo gyiwye gayi dna n shekwoyi ɓeye nyi .
yi kpelo ge aɓo vinya nɓa bwayi ɓa lo tnu-tnu manayi n yi aba , ndei yi ye shekwoyi lo , yi-i kunce lo nwo shiri yi .
ntuge , tunyi n kmisunyi , shekwoyi ɓei ku da aza vinya n ɓa ɓe wo aba , wo ɓei n cei pma-kpe aza nɓa ɓa ɓe – ɓa ze ngye owo nugun , n na bai owo nugun wa ze oza kmisunyi dna nwo azaje .
shi wa kni yi , wa yi yi nge yi ɓe dawo , sanu n ya ɓe ncei wa ze yi ge , “ tna laifi da , ” wa nuyi n kristi ɓemanayi wa gayi agni-gni manayi n wohin yi , wa zhin yi alkawali owo mwa-mwa nya .
yi ɓa da gena tu aɓe a wo-woi ye tukwoʼa ?
ndei shekwoyi malo n yi bwa , nyikado nu ɓa zhin gaba n yiya ?
tunda wo to kni wo nugun gnin , ama wa gawo ntu yi ɓo vinya , wota gayi anya vinya ngnisun nwoyin ?
nyikado ɓa da ɓeda nukwoyi tu n yi tukwo , aza n shekwoyi laɓa kni ɓa ze owo nya ?
shekwoyi ?
awo , owo nu na zhin yi gafara wa gayi agni-gni manayi n wohin yi .
nyikado ɓa zunyi knia ?
kristi nu ɓa zun yi kni ?
awo , gama owo nu na fi n yi ɓo , wa la kala n efi ntu yi ɓo , woi sase tulo n shekwoyi aba , n latu dnagmayi aba , woi gyi wye gayi n eshemi .
nyikado nu ɓa gwo yi kristi yeye ya ?
sanu n ya sin wahala kwo a zhin , sanu n na zan yi shin kwo zawuyi , ntuge wota ye yi lonu ?
sanu mikun gunyi to yi ye n gyiwye yin , ko yi dna n na a-zhin-gye kwo aye awuyi , shekwoyi n ku yi ya n nu ?
awo , gama littafi a gnayi , ntu n wo ɓo tilas ya zhin shiri ya sin wahala n saho-sahoyi , yi wu ngye akni nu n ɓa pmi a wuɓa .
nna ɓeye vinya , nasara zhin yi nyanu dna kristi n wa ye yi wa fi ntu n yi ɓo nyi .
ntuge mila gaiciya ga nyaho tami kwa gnayi aje n shekwoyi yeye yi n .
efi ta min , wyewyei ta min , a malayika ta min , anapi kala vinya ta min kwa gwo yi shekwoyi yeye yan , eyi dnawo n naiye nya , n bugba wun yi nsu nya yi .
kwo aba n yi nyi , n eshe bmana , dna n nuwan yakwo min , nyaho ta mi kwa gnayi ajeya n shekwoyi yeye yin n wa wuyi dna n yesu kristi , sanu n wa fi n yi ɓo nyin .
- 3 o , omi aza a israila yi !
o , om azaje yahudiyi , shi mi n cei pma lo n mwa fya ɓe kristi aba .
omi bugba wo mi shan lo , bugba yi wun mi n nyipyei n sukwoyi ntu n fye ɓo .
kristi kpelo , zafun gyi-gyi-yi kpelo , nge mi ta da egbe ɓeda nun , sanu n ma cige mi yelo a mi gmiya n shekwoyi ebe mi , ngye deye ɓa zhin fye fya bwa gni-gni .
shekwoyi ku anya ga fye n mwa , ama fye ta wo wo lon .
wa kni fye n gye owo aza yeyeyi , wa kni fye wa gni fye busi n wo buzagna mwamwai , wa wufye shiwo n cei pma wa tu fye anabarka , wa ga fye owo awyidna ntu n fye a sese ɓo n na bai fya kpe enya n wo ye fya zhin .
wa fa fye fya zhin wo sujada wa ga fye alkawali a adnagmai .
aza dnagmayi shekwoyi anya efye zakwoyi nu kristi nwohin , ɓei gmi nfye nuwo zhin yahudiyi nu dna n nayi owo nwo gyibe tu n na anya she vinya nsaiye nyi .
mwa-mwa n shekwoyi aba nyalo-nyalo .
to , shekwoyi ta mi lo nu wa nuwo alkawali n na yahudiyi abarn ?
awo : ( ntuge alkawaliye zhin aza nya nu nɓa zhin a yahudiyi hin-hin nyi . ) aza vinya nu to n na maɓa fi n na yahudiyi fye , n ɓa zhin a yahudiyi hin-hin .
oɓa kun-kun n ibrahim , ta zhin ɓa ɓa ze ibrahim aɓin , shekwoyi ɓeda , nku da nge alkawali zhin ishaku , ibrahim nugun anyanu , n ishaku ayawyi yi .
koda yake ibrahim ɓei n na aɓi ajeyi .
kwa wu nu ge ibrahim aɓi vinya nu to zhin shekwoyi aɓin , ama aza nɓa ga alkawali gni-gni nya gaiciya n wo ɓei zhin ibrahim nyi .
shekwoyi ku alkawali zhin nge , “ ntna , oho n saratu yi n ɓei ga fye oɓi ” .
- 13 aye n mwa begye n navun sanu n wo nugun ishaku ɓei la wo nyikwo la , owo nyikwo rifkatu , woi la ga aɓi ma a-za-ba , shekwoyi wa gna wo isuwa oɓi n na ɓa ma kmisunyi nyi , wo ɓa zhin yakubu owo mado bara .
dna n shekwoyi ɓeda , “ mi la yakubu kni ma tuwo anabarka to ge isuwam ” .
shekwoyi ɓei dace to ai ma aɓi yen , to ɓai kpe ɓemanayi ye n ɓenukwoyi n sapa .
wo to ɓei zhin ce ntu n naɓo nu n na ɓi ɓei zhin m , ama nya n shekwoyi ɓei ye wa kni .
shekwoyi ɓei zhin ɓenukwoyi nu ?
ntuge shekwoyi ɓei ku gna musa ge , n ɓa wu oza alheri n ma ye , magye oza sun-sun n ma ye .
ntu lonu , shekwoyi ta ga anabarka ntu ge oza kun ce wa bwa kwo nun , kwo wa zhin tnu-tnu n kala yi wa bwan , wo bwa ntuge , shekwoyi gye oza sun-sun nu n wa ye ko n wa gye dama .
firauna , masar esu ɓei zhin ɓesisi nu gaiciya ye nya .
ntuge shekwoyi ɓei ku gnawo ge wo la masar ebe ga wo ntuge wa wuwo shekwoyi iko n wo tukwo .
n nabai anyi vinya ɓa wo shekwoyi eye mwa-mwa .
ntu lonu fye gye , shekwoyi wu azaho alheri ntu ge wo n cei pmanu , wa zhin azaho n na tukwoi kwa gnana to ɓa wo ɓon .
to , kni nu zhin shekwoyi woi gye ɓa laifi , nge ɓata wo lo n ma ?
ɓa to zhin oɓo n wa gna ɓa ge ɓa zhin ?
aʼa to dalo nun , ho zhin kni nua ha zan shekwoyi zanshin n laifi a ?
enya n na zhin ko , kwo ɓa mi kwa gna oza n wa zhin kwo nyi ge kni na zhin hoi zhin mi n layia ?
sanu n oza mi shakun , wo to n ikoyi lo wa zhin apma n ezun yi gmanyi wa mi shakun manayi ntu n zhedu ɓo wa mido ntu n pashe fi ɓon ?
shekwoyi to n ikoyi lo wa wu wo minagyi n na aza tukwo n ɓa kuncelo a wuɓan , aza n wa zhin hakuri nɓai n sai mwa n ?
- 24 wo n zokwo yi lo-lo , nge eyi n na akuyi ze aza n wa ze owo mwa-mwa ya kpe ɓa , ko yi zhin a yahudiyi nu , ko yi zhin abyedo nu , wa wuyi alheri n na bai aza vinya ɓa gye shi owo mwamwa nsun .
fye pa lo enya n hosia anabci a da ?
shekwoyi wa cige , “ wo ɓa bwa abye do ga wohin ( aza nɓa ta kun n na yahudiyi byen ) wa ye ɓa ko da yake oza to shin ɓa yen . ”
aza n na ɓei zhin ai ciɓa ge , “ fye to zhin omi aza nun , ” aɓa yi ɓa nsai ge , shekwoyi wye-wyei da aɓi .
ishaya anabi ɓei da ɓo n na a yahudiyi tukwo wa cige , koda yake ɓa ɓa mwa begye ngye amwi n ela gbe , aza n bwasun ciwyi nu n ɓa ɓei pwo n ɓami .
“ ntuge dagayi ɓei dawa n na anyi tukwo wa zo owo atnu-tnu n ɓai wa zun ɓa ya kpekpegye . ”
ishaya wa je gna n na abado nge nto n shekwoyi sun-sun gyei nun , aɓei wu a yahudiyi vinya , oɓa vinya shi aɓei wu aza vinya n ɓa ɓei fi n sodon n gomora zhimi nyi .
to , yi ɓa da ge nana n na ɓeye tukwoa ?
yiɓa cige shekwoyi la esa ga abye aje woi zhin ɓa gafara dna n gaiciya gami , ko da yake ɓa ta zan shekwoyi zanshin .
ama , a yahudiyi n ɓa zhin atna ɓa bwa agni-gni manayi ntu n na awyidna bwashi ɓo , ɓato gyi nasaran .
ntu n kniɓei nua ?
ntuge ɓa ɓei zhin atna ɓa bwa gni-gni ntu n na awyidna bwashi n atnazhinyi ɓaze aza manayi maimakon ɓaga gaiciya , ɓaku ce bonyi n kuta bonyicenya dnagmayi .
shekwoyi ɓo ku pma ɓa gna dna nwo ɓeda wa cige , “ mila apma shi na a yahudiyi zokwo , aza n mwa begye ɓa ce bonyi n wo ( yesu ) aza n ɓa gawo gaiciya vinyikwo ta wo ɓam . ”
omi azaje omi bugba ɓeye n mi aduwa yi nu nyi nge a yahudiyi ɓa bwa gni-gni .
mi kpe ɓa bugbadna ye lo n ɓa cei lo ntu shekwoyi latu ɓo , ama bugbadna deye zhin gbeloyi nu .
ntuge ɓata kpe genyi lo nge kristi la fi ntu ge wa zhin ɓa zhi n shekwoyi aba , ama ɓai zeze ɓai zhin atna ɓa zhin ɓemana n na bai ɓa bwa shekwoyi agmada dna n na yahudiyi a wyidna n na knunu yi , ama ɓa nu to zhin shekwoyi gni-gni zokwo m .
ɓata kpe genyi lo ge , kristi ga aza nu n ɓa ga gaiciya , anya vinya n ɓa zhin atna ɓa bwa , dna n na awyidna bwashin .
woɓo ku ce zo vinya .
ntuge musa ɓei ku ka , ge ngye oza ɓa mi wa zhin ɓemanayi , to wa zhin ɓenukwoyin , wa gyi nasara n jarabai dna n wo asese , n na ba yi nu , n naɓa zhin wo gafara wa pwo !
ama gni-gni n kwo ɓe ntu gaiciya ga ɓo kwo cige , “ koto n na apmai lo ba zan nshemi ntuge ha gmi kristi ɓe n cei n wa bma ho zhin .
koto n na apmai lo ha lo ho zan wo shin dna n na azafin aba ha jewo ze ɓe ncei n efin . ”
ntuge gni-gni n kwo ɓe dna n gaiciya ga n kristi , ekwo nu zhin nya n yi zhin waʼazi , kwo to mwa kpa lon n zaho-zaho yin , ɓehin-hin kwo wo viviyi lo n yi ngye , eyi abugba n yi agbei .
ntuge n ha gna aza n ho gbeyi nge kristi yesu nu zhin ho dagayi ha ga gaiciya nho bugbami nge shekwoyi lawo laka n vingwo , ho ɓa pwo .
gama dna n gaiciya ga nu nbugba n oza bwa gnigni manayi n shekwoyi aba , n wo gbeyi nu njesun n wo gna aza owo gaiciya ga ɓo .
gama shekwoyi ɓeda gna yi ge , oza to lo n wo ga kristi gaiciya vinyikwo kwa wo won .
a yahudiyi n na tna kaciya zhinyi gmanyi nu , oɓa dagayi gmanyi nu n wo gaɓa anya vinya , n ɓa nya wo n bugbai gmanyi nyi .
oza n wa yi shekwoyi eye wo ɓa pwo .
ama ɓaɓa nya wo n wuna nge wo gniɓa a kpe baga gaiciya ?
ɓai ɓa gawo gaiciya n wuna to ɓai wo wo ɓon ma ?
ɓai ɓa wo wo ɓo n wuna to ozai gna ɓan ma ?
oza ɓa lo n wuna wo gna ɓa to ai tnu wo ma ?
nya nu n shekwoyi ɓeda da sanu n kwa ci n cei ge , “ gye shi oɓa apita bmiya oɓanu nɓa zhin bugba fun nabari manayi shekwoyi nya waʼazi , ɓai ɓe n nabari a gmada nyai .
aza a yeyeyi nu aza n ɓa zhin shekwoyi nabari manayi waʼazi nyi . ”
ama aza vinya nu to n ɓa wo nabari manayi ɓa gwon .
ntuge anabi ishaya ɓei ku da “ dagayi nyikado la gaiciya ga ɓo n ma gna ɓa nyiʼa ? ”
ama gaiciya ga ɓe n shekwoyi ɓeda wonu , nabari manayi kristi nya .
ama a yahudiyi ma ?
ɓaku shekwoyi ɓeda wo ?
e , gama kwola lo aba n ɓa nyi vinya .
aku nabari manayi zhin waʼazi har anyi ce zhi ba .
ama ɓa ɓei ku awyega bwa ( nge shekwoyi ɓa ga aza je gni-gni to ɓai ya gwon ? ) e , ntuge tunyi n musa sa , shekwoyi ɓei ku gna ge , wo ɓa zhin owo aza ɓa wo oshe , wa zhin atna wa kun ɓa agyewyi n wa gni-gni ga abyedo atna cei .
ishaya ɓei je da ntna edna ge , aza nɓa to zan shekwoyi shin ɓa ɓa bwa wo .
nsaiye , wo zhin atna lo wa si a yahudiyi kpe , ama ɓa gyi abye na ɓenayi , to ɓai ye ge ɓa ɓem .
ma nya ɓo , shekwoyi ku owo aza a yahudiyi yanu ?
awo , ko fye wyi , fye pa ge mi zhin yahudiyi nu n mihin , ibrahim yawyi n banyami bye .
- 3 awo , shekwoyi to yawo aza n wakni tunyi n sapan , fye pa ɓolo n littafi a da tu ɓeye tukwo ?
anabi iliya ɓei cibwi kpe shekwoyi ntu n na yahudiyi tukwo , shi a ku shekwoyi anabi wu , ai la shekwoyi a bagadi ɓaya , iliya ɓei gye ge owo nu bwa cedna n knihin n wo gmanyi woi ye shekwoyi , ɓa zhin a tna ɓa wuwo n wohin .
fye pa amsa lo n shekwoyi ɓei gawo ?
“ shekwoyi ɓei ciwo ge , awo , oho nu to ce n ho gmanyi yin .
mi n na azayi lo lo dubu tnaba n ɓa yemi lo , bai to gba shan . ”
kwo wu lo lo nu n naiye .
a yahudiyi vinya nu to pmi avun wu shekwoyin .
azalo fyewyi n na gniɓa ntu n shekwoyi alheri ɓo n wa kniɓa .
ngye shekwoyi alheri nu agye oɓa ɓemana zhin nu ton , nzokwoye cauta to shan kyauta nu zhin , kwo to zhin cauta nu , zai ya zhin tnu-tnu nu wa bwan .
kwo wulo n lonu , a yahudiyi n mwa to bwa shekwoyi alheri nɓa zanshin .
fyewyi n ku bwa aza n shekwoyi wa kni-ama aza nɓa ce nyi awye n ku ɓa bua .
nyanu n shekwoyi ɓeda da sanu n kwo ci n cei ge , shekwoyi laɓa shigye , woi guɓa awye n na tunbuayi n na bai to ɓa kpe oɓo ye n yi da , sa n ya gna ɓa kristi ɓo n cei .
kwo wulo n lonu nu har naiye .
dauda esu ɓei ku ce da sanu n wo ɓei ci n cei ge , “ fwa oɓa nyagyi manayi n anabarka do yi kwo pi ɓa agam ɓagye nge ɓeho to lo n ɓa ; tasin n shekwoyin .
fa anya a manayi ye ɓa je zekpe ɓa , ɓa wuɓa , ɓa ɓa ɓaya .
fa oɓa awye ɓa dna wyegma n na bai to ɓa gye wyeban , ɓa zan-zan n ya kpe ntu n na kaya shan wo ɓo . ”
kwa wunu , nge shekwoyi ku owo aza ya har abada ?
awo , owo nufi n na bai abyedo ɓa bwa pwopwo .
n na bai ɓa yahudiyi ɓa wo she ɓa ya shekwoyi gni-gni zanshin ga ɓahin .
nsaiye , ndei anyi vinya ku nya bwa ntu shekwoyi gni-gni ɓo , sanu n na yahudiyi ɓa ce bonyi to ɓa ye kwom .
ai anyi ɓei gna anabarka bwa sanu n a yahudiyi ɓa gwo kristi .
shi fye kpelo ge , shekwoyi lami kni owo tnu-tnu yi nfye aba abyedo , mi gnafye , mi-i ce a yahudiyi ɓepa shi mi ɓa mi nsun .
nna bai n kwo yezhin ma zhin ɓa ɓa ye enya n fye abyedo n cei lo , n zokwoyi magni azaho nɓa mi .
kwo ɓei ze ɓe wowo ɓai ya ze a kristi viyi .
sa n shekwoyi ɓei pmiya n ɓa aba kwa wunu nge wo ɓei pmida anyi wa gaɓa gni-gni .
nsai ye kwo dulo n ɓewowoyi a yahudiyi ɓa ɓe da kristi .
kwo ɓei ze ngye aza fi nu na je kukala n efi .
shi ibrahim n na anabi yi zhin shekwoyi a zanu nyi , oɓa ɓi ɓa ze shekwoyi aza ce , ntuge n shinwan gbegye gyi-gyi-yi okwa bwala ɓa ze a gyi-gyi-yi nu ce .
ama a bwala ho n ibrahim shinwa , a yahudiyi ho , ala ɓa kaya , efye abyedo a bwala a bmana nya , ngye zaitun bmana nya bwala , a fyefyegyi .
nlonu n saiye fyei gwo anabarka n shekwoyi ɓei ga ibrahim n wo aɓiyi ɓai sin shinwa gma n shekwoyi wa nu n wohin tukwoyi .
fye zhin peceiye kada fya gma ntuge aku fye fi n ɓa apita nu .
fye pa nge a kpe fye ye ntuge fye filo n shekwoyi shinwa nu , fye zhin abwala nu fye to zhin a gbegye nun .
“ to ” ko yezhin lo ha cige aɓei ibma a bwalai ya ntuge a fyemi nu gyi , ntu cenu mi zhin ɓo lo n kwo kunce .
fye zhin peceiye .
pa ge a bwala ho , a yahudiyi a ɓei bma ɓa ya ntu ge ɓato ɓei ga shekwoyi gaiciya nun , fye zhi n ya ntuge fya gawo gaiciya nu .
fyeto zhin aɓo-kwon , gye gba fyehin tukwo fya zhin igodiya , fya zhin peceiye .
ntuge n shekwoyi to fa abwala nwafi ɓa tunyi n sapan , wo ta fa fyehin .
shi awye hagye shi shekwoyi zhin alheri dna ɓo , wo gyiminagyi n na azai nɓa ta vi wo ɓon , ama wo zhin ɓemana ga fye fyei ya gyi abye fya yewo n gaiciya gayi , ama nfye to zhin lo nu m aɓa zun fye ya .
n zokwo do , nna yahudiyi fa ɓa tna gaiciya ga ɓa jeze ɓe da shekwoyi , shekwoyi ɓa je ɓa fyegyi n shinwa .
wo n ikoyi lo wa zhin lonu .
ntu ge n gye shi shekwoyi ɓei la ye wa gwo fye n fye ɓei mwa kpa n woi , n fye ɓei zhin zaitun bmana nya bwala , wa fye fyegyi n wo shinwa manayi onya nna ta shin zhin-fye gye ge woto gni n shiri yi nu zhin wa je a yahudiyi gwo n jesun n ɓa ɓei shin fi n kmisunyi nyin ?
mi n cei pma fya kpe gaiciya ye n shekwoyi aba , emi azaje yeyeyi n na bai nfye ta mwa fyehin tukwo fya ya abokwo zhin , e , kwo zhin gaiciya nu nge a yahudiyi ho zhin gaba lo n nabari manayi-nsaiye , ama kwo ɓa bwa esanu la n fye abyedo fya ku ɓe kristi aba vinya , efye n fya ye fya ɓe .
n navun israila vinya ɓapwo .
fye pa oɓo lo n anabi ɓo da n ɓeye tukwo ?
“ gniyi ɓa gmi n sihiyona , wa pmi a yahudiyi awye ya n ɓenukwoyi zhin .
nsayi mɓei kuɓa a laifi ya , she ma zhin ɓa alkawali ” .
nsaiye , a yahudiyi n mwa begye zhin anuwuyi nu nabari manayi nya .
degye n la ze gyiba nfye aba , ntuge kola ɓe efye abyedo n shekwoyi cauta yi , har nsaiye a yahudiyi zhin shekwoyi aza yeyeyi nu , ntu n wo alkawali ɓo n wo ɓei zhin ibrahim , ishaku n yakubu yi nyi .
gama shekwoyi cauta n wo yiyi-i kwo ta shan kman , wotajeze n na vunyi n wo alkawali n wa zhin nyin .
nsapai , fye ɓei zhin shekwoyi a nuɓai nu , ama sa n na yahudiyi ɓei na shekwoyi cauta aɓo wa gye fyenu sun-sun .
nsayi ye a yahudiyi nu zhin tawaye ama n wyihoi ɓa ɓei gni shekwoyi sun-sun gye bwa n fyei .
gama shekwoyi ku ɓa ya ga ɓenukwoi zhin n nabai wa gye aza sun-sun vinya .
o , shekwoyi , ɓo wo-woyi danu n yi n cei .
owo wyemwa , n wo ɓeyekpei n wo nyabwai kwo dna ɓo lo ya kpe owo shawara ye n wo azokwoi .
nyikadonu n yi mi kpe shekwoyi bugba yelo a ?
nyikadonu n ɓeyekpei lo wa ga shekwoyi shawara wa wu wo zokwo a ?
nyikado nu ɓa ga shekwoyi nya kunce kwa zhin wo wa zhin ɓo a ?
gama anya vinya kun n shekwoyi aba nu .
anya vinya bwa wye-wyei dna nwo ikonu .
anya vinya nyi ntu wo latu ɓo nu .
mwa-mwa nwo aba nyalo-nyalo amin .
ntu cenu mi gyi fye wye fya gafye anayi n shekwoyi akun , ɓa ze hadaya wye-wyei gyi-gyi-yi nya , odo pya n wo ɓa gwo .
nfya pa oɓo ɓo n wa zhin fye , deye duwyi lo wa nya fye ?
fye to shan hali n na kunnu anyi nya yi n , ama fye ku ze aza woi-woi n naɓo nfye ɓa n zhin , nfye nubo zhinyi .
nlonu fye ɓa kpe nfye aɓo-mutu shiwo zokwo ɓa fu fye nubo .
ngye shekwoyi tnu-tnuyi mi ga zaho-zahoi nfye mi shekwoyi pmagna : fye zhin gaiciya n fyehin tukwo ɓo , fyei mwi shi shekwoyi wa ga fye gaiciya-ga n sun .
- 5 shi agalo n mwa begye n fye nayi n lo nu kristi nayi .
yi zhin aga nu owo nayi nya , zaho-zahoi n yi mi woi nu kwo ntuge yi n na tnu-tnuyi lo gbo-gbo .
shekwoyi , n gbai ga zaho-zahoi n yi mi nwo ɓa zhin ɓa n bmiya n shekwoyi n la anabci zhin gba nu ga fye , zhin anabci nsai vinya n ho ɓa mi – n sai vinya , n ho gaiciya ga n kalai lo n ho ɓa gwo tnu-tnu-tnu shekwoyi aba .
ngye ho nyaga zhin aza bmazhin nyanu , bma ɓa zhin cewo .
ngye ho zhin malami nu wu nya n bmiya .
ngye ho zhin waʼazi zhin yi nu kpe ge eho waʼazi n kalai lo n bmazhin yi dna .
n shekwoyi la gyiwye gaho , bma azaje zhin n cei .
n shekwoyi la aza bwashi tnu-tnu ga ho woi ku azafiho n nakun zhin tnu-tnu n ho kala yi .
aza n ba zhin abugba zhi-zhi da a tna ɓa zhin kwo n bugba a kristi yi nya yi .
to ye aza n gbeyin , yeɓa cewo .
to ye enya n kwo to bmiyan , ye ɓemana ha zhin kwo .
fye ye n na ajei ngye aya-ɓi , fya ga aje mwamwa n bugba buibui .
fye to wo bwato nfye tnu-tnu yin , ama fye zhin dagayi tnu-tnu n bugba bui , bui .
dagma n tu nyaɓo n shekwoyi z hin gaho , zhin hakuri n wahalai , ha zhin aduwa ci-ci .
sanu shekwoyi aɓi gyisan , bma ɓa zhin , zhin ha yi azhiɓei ɓa ɓe nyagyi nho puwa ko kwa nɓa ye agyewan aba n sukwoyi .
n oza zhin fye ɓenukwoyi ntuge fye zhin kristi nya nu , to tu wo eknin , zhin adduwa shekwoyi wa tuwo anabarka .
sa n na aza dagma ha dagma n ɓai , n ɓa wun bugba ha bma ɓa bugba wun .
fye zhin tnu-tnu n dagma ngnisun .
to zhin n gye ho zhin zadnagmayin .
to lodna n na aza yakwo aban , ama gnalo n ha sharayi .
to ha ci a ɓo n gye ho kpe ɓeho ye lon .
to gba ɓenukwoyi ta n ɓenukwoyin .
zhin ɓeho-ɓehoyi cewo , aza kpe ge hoto zhin zakata nun .
to wu anya n zaho-zahoi .
bwa bugba buyi n na azai vinya ngye shi ho ɓa mi .
emi anugundo ye-yeyi fyeto gba ɓe ta ga fyehin .
fa kwo ga shekwoyi ntuge wo ku gna ge wo ɓa gba aza n kwo kunce .
fye to la owa dna n fye akun .
( wato fye to zun owa gnan ) .
gaho nuwunyi nya gyi mikun ya gun wo , n nuwan mikun wo-wo gawo nuwan wa sin .
ho ye anakna nu kpe wo n tukwo , wato vinyikwo ɓa wo wo n ɓo woku zhin ho nyi .
to fya ye ɓenukwoyi kwa gyi ebe tu nfye tukwon , ama fye zun ɓenukwoyi kni dna a ɓemanayi izhin .
fye ku ze aɓo vi-yi n na aza ba nɓa gyi ebe nyi , ntuge shekwoyi nu na kpe ɓa n ɓo .
ebe ho to lo n shekwoyi nu to shi kwo n wo iko yin .
ntu cenu aza n ɓata shi ekni awyidna bwan shekwoyi nu n ɓa ta vi wo ɓom .
tata ɓa vi ɓa n na avun .
gama abusi-ɓiyi-da ta wan aza n ɓa zhin ɓefyecen , ama oza n wo zhin ɓenukwoyi tilas nu wa wo wo dna .
shi awyi-dna bwa ɓoho ta bwa hon .
shekwoyi tnu n na busi ɓiyi-da yi ɓa bma fye nu zhin .
ama n ho zhin ɓenukwoyi tilas ha wo wo dna ntuge wo ɓa wan ho .
shekwoyi wa tnu n woi n cenu .
shi awyidna bwa ntu a ɓo ɓo ngun aba , kmisunyi , n na bai to a wan hon , bayi , ntuge ho kpe lo ge kwo kunce lo .
fye gba gadu cewo , ntu aɓoye ɓo n gun aba .
ntuge a gba a tnu-tnu zhinyi n na bai ɓa gyi abye n shekwoyi tnu-tnu zhin yi , ɓai zhin fye bauta .
fye gba ozaho-zahoi nya n kwo kunce , fye gba ofye gadu n bugba bui-bui , fye vi aza ɓo nɓa kpe n fye she .
fye ga aza mwa-mwa n kwo kunce nɓayi .
fye gba ofye ata vinya , a kpe yeye ta fye to zo kwo gban , ntuge n fya ye n ɓayi fye zhin shekwoyi ɓeye nu , fyei shi wo awyidna bwa .
n ha ye n ho zado yi shi ho ye n hohin sun , hota ye ha gyi wo fin , ho taye ha wu won kwo ha wyiwo vim .
hoi ta zhin ɓe nukwoyi n wo nyikwo yin kwo ha ye enya n wo n ceyin , kwo ha zhin ɓe n na awyidna ngu n awo agna nge ato zhin .
ngun awo vinya pupuru fi n gmanyi ye nu .
ha ye n ho zado yi shi ho ye n hohin tukwoyi .
yeye ta zhin za ɓenukwoyin .
cenu zhin kwoi nu zfiin aɓo vinya n shekwoyi ye , wyidna gmanyi nu n fyeye .
asese n bmiya dalili nyi n jesun .
fye kpe shi esa n la gba , esa busilo .
la kun a gyewyi ntuge , dagayi ɓe ɓe la gnawo vivi n du esa n yi ɓei ga gaiciya n cei .
- 13 sukwo n la duya , owo ɓe-ɓe nyipyeyi la ga ɓe , ntuce , fye kma ɓe nukwoyi zhin ya , fya kpe ɓemana zhin .
shi kwo kunce a buzanga da sase .
fye zhin ɓemana fya zhin gaiciya n na aɓo vinya n fye ɓa zhin n na bai aza da fye ɓo manayi .
fye to wunsa ya n na gnikwo gniyi , n jesin yi , n na anagbayi zhinyi , n shakpeyi , n gu sun yi , kwo eshen .
ama gyi kristi wye wa bma ho zhin , ha sase shi kwo kunce , to ha zhin shaula ha dagma dna n ɓenukwoyi zhin m .
a fye gwo oza n wo ye wa ɓe da fye kwo owo gaiciya ga kwoi gba kala .
to zunwo kni ntuge owo aɓonubozhin wulo gbo n ho nyai , tu aɓo tukwo n kwo bmiya n doi n kwo to bmiyan .
misali , to na aɓo n woi n na abugyi tukwo n na zun sha ga eshan .
ho ga gaiciya , nya ho to wunya lo nkwon , ama azaje gaiciyaga gba kala lo , ɓa gye kwo zhin nukwoyi nu , ɓata gyi abun sai dai ɓa gyi afintolo , cei ya cece ge ɓa gyi abuyi pya .
aza n ɓa gye kwo to wunya lo ɓa gyi abuyi pyan , ɓato ci aza wyegba n ɓata gyin .
nho ta gyin to gye ɓa laifi n ɓa gyi nyin .
ntuge shekwoyi la ɓa gwo ɓa ze owo aɓi .
ɓa zhin shekwoyi a bara nu , ofye nyanu ton oɓa nuwan lo n wo abanu toge nfye aban , fye fa wa gna ɓa kwo kwo bmiya lo , kwo kwo to bmiya lon , shekwoyi ɓami wa zhin ɓa ɓa zhin shi kwo kunce .
azaho zhin nubo ge a yesu viyi ɓa shi a yahudiyi anyipyeyi asun-sun nya nu bwa , anyipyeyi n ɓa ɓa ga shekwoyi mwa-mwa n cei , ama aza ho ci ge kwo zhin gbelohi nu nya zenu za zhin aɓei pya , ntuge anyipyeyi vinya zhin shekwoyi anya nu .
nna beye pya ozaho-zahoi nu ɓa zhin oɓo n kwo kunce .
nho n na anyipyeyi kni hoi ga shekwoyi mwamwa , ho ye ha lawo tu ho zhin ɓe manayi nu .
nlo nunce oza n wo gyi abu n na zun sha ga eshan .
wo sa shekwoyi ami ntu nkwo ɓo , wo zhin ɓe manayi nu , oza ce n wo ta to abuyi bwan , wo zhin atna nu wa zhin oɓo n kwo da dagayi , woi zhin godiya .
yi to zhin eyihin tukwo adagayi nu n , n yi ɓami ya kni ge yi bwa wye-wyei ko ya fin .
kwo yi n wye-wyei , kwo yi fi yi zhin dagayi anya nu .
zokwo doho-dohoyi zhin wo anya nu .
kristi ɓei fi wa laka njesun ntu n na aɓeye ɓo nu .
n na bai wo ɓa zhin yi dagayi kwo yi nwye-wyei , kwo yi ku fi .
hoto n iko yi lo ha zun ho zado kni kwo ha ciwo wyegban .
pa ge , ozaho-zahoi n yi mi wo ɓei gni agni gni n shekwoyi wada a sese ɓa n wada wyi yi .
ntuge , a cei kafi “ shi mi nyi ” , nyikutukwo dohodohoi ɓei ce a kwo-kwo n mi abye , nyitala doho-dohoi ɓei ye abui n shekwoyi aba .
behin-hin , zahozahoi ɓei ga wohin tukwo nyadoku n shekwoyi aba .
ntu cenu , fye to zhin aje laifi zanshin .
fye zhin atna fya sase , n fye ta zhin ofye do wa ce bwoyin , n na ɓo n wo ɓa gye ho hoi zhin n wo zhin nubwo ge ɓato bmiya lon .
nmi aba , mi kpelo lalle dna n dagayi yesu iko , nyaho to wunya lon , n na abu gyi yi n na zun sha ga eshan .
ama , nza gna ge kwo zhin ɓenukwoyi nu , to , wo to zhin m , ntuge n wo aba kwoto bmiya lon .
ngye oho zaho damu lon nyayi n ho gyi , hota zhin yeye ɓe zhin nun , n ha gyi abye n gyi yin .
to fa oho nyagyi kwa zhin oza n kristi wa fi n wo ɓo wa bwin .
to zhin oɓo n kwo ɓa ɓe ho n wyegba-ciyi , kwo hoi kpelo ge kwo bmiya lon .
gama aɓo kpakaiayi n yi a yesu viyi aba , kwo nu to zhin nyagyi n nyasin yi , ama ɓemana , bugba fu , n na agmada yi n zafun gyi-gyi-yi aba .
nfya fa kristi wa zhin dagayi dna n na ɓeye vinya , aɓa da shekwoyi .
n na azaje yi .
yi zhin atna ya zhin aɓo nɓa ɓa ɓe nbugbafuyi , ya mi aje zhi .
fye to wun shekwoyi tnu-tnu ya ntu na abu ɓon .
fye pa nge nyaho towun ya lon , n na bugyi yin , ama kwo wunya lo sa nu n kwa zhin ozado wa ce bwonyi .
oɓo n kwo bmiya okwo nu ha fa abugyi , ko jesin , kwo nya zhin n kwo ɓa zhin ohozado wa ce bonyi , wa zhin laifi .
ho ɓami ha kpe ge nyaho to wunya lo n nya yi n ho zhin , kwo n shekwoyi aba , ama kuce shin hohin , to wu ho gaiciya ga nza aba n kwo ɓa zhin wo wa ce bonyin .
n na ɓeye pya , bugba bui-bui da nu oza n wota zhin laifi nɓe yi n wo kpe ge kwo bmiya n .
ama nza kpe ge ɓo nwo ye wa zhin nyi kwoto bmiya lon , wo to zhin kwon wo zhin laifinu woi ya zhin , ntuge wo zhin nubo ge kwo zhin ɓenukwoi nu .
ntu cenu n wo aba kwo to bmiya lon .
nyaho-nyahoi nza zhin woi gye ge kwo to bmiya lon kwo zhin laifi nu .
- 2 kwo yi-i gye ge aɓeye to zhin nyaho nu n shekwoyi aba kwo yi ya zhin ɓan , yita mi ya gyi abye ya zhin ɓan , ntuge ya da yihin agman , tile ya pa azaje ɓo nɓa shakai n dna , nɓa gye ge aɓeye to bmiya lo nyin .
yi zhin ɓo n kwo ɓa da azaje to ge eyihin , ya zhin ɓo n kwo ɓa bma wo zhin kwa miwo gni dna n dagayi .
kristi to zhin ɓo n kwo dawo num , she , zabura ka yi wa da “ waɓe n tuge , wa sin wahala , n na za kun nɓa wun dagayi nu nyi . ”
aɓeye n na cei kafi n litafi tunyi n sapa nyi , a kafi ntuge ɓa wuyi-atnazhin n bugba kala bwayi nu .
nnabayi ya pmi peceiye n hakuri yi har ewyi n shekwoyi ɓe zun laifi kni n efiyi .
shekwoyi n wo ga hakuri , n migniyi , n bugba kala yi , wo bma fye zhin fya sase n na jeyi n bugba dayi za-zai wuwo do kristi hali .
nsayi , eyi vinya yami ci dagayi n begye yi gmanyi , yi ga shekwoyi mwa-mwa , eyi dagayi yesu kristi dada .
ntu lonu fye ye , n na jeyi n ikklisiya , shi kristi wa gwo fye n bugba bui-bui n na bai n shekwoyi eye ɓa latu .
fye pa ge , yesu kristi wa ɓe wa wu ge shekwoyi ta daɓo wa pman , njesun wa bma a yahudiyi zhin .
njesun fye pa ge waɓe n na bai abyedo ɓa bwa gnigni , ɓa ga shekwoyi mwa-mwa ntu wo sun-sun gye ɓo .
nyanu n zabura kayi wa da , sanu n wo ɓei ka n cei ge , “ mba ciho dna n abyedo , ma la oho ye tu . ”
nna abado , “ fye dagma , ofye abyedo ngnisun nwo azayi a yahudiyi . ”
njesun , “ fye ci dagayi , ofye abyedo , fa aza vinya ɓa ciwo . ”
anabi ishaya wa cige “ gado gyiyi ɓa gmi n jese puwa , wa gyi be tu n abyedo tukwo , ɓa ɓei tu awye n wo nu vinya . ”
nlonu mi zhin aduwa ga fye abyedo , n na bai shekwoyi n wo gafye awye tunyi , wa ga fye a gmada n bugbafu yi , shi fya gawo gaiciya .
mi zhin aduwa n shekwoyi ɓa nu fye n awyetu yi dna n zafun gyi-gyi-yi iko n wo dna n fye nyi .
mi kpe lo fye zhin aza manayi nu n ceceyi , omi azaje , fye kpe aɓeye ye lo n fye ɓami fya wu azaje ɓa .
- 16 ama mi n bugba kalayi lo ma je fye aɓeye gna , mi kpe lo fye ye ma pa fye ɓanu kawai , ntuge n shekwoyi alheri yi , mi zhin tnutnuyi nu n yesu krisiti wa tnu fye n cei abyedo .
mi ɓefye n nabari manayi mi-i ga fye ngye hadaya n shekwoyi akun , ntuge ala fye zhanya , fyei zhin ɓo wo ye dna n zafun gyi-gyi-yi .
ntu lonu mi gye kwo bmiya lo ma gma , ntu anya ɓo vinya n kristi yesu ku zhin dna n mi nyi .
mi ta ye ma daɓo shi wa zhin tnu-tnu n na azajeyi nun , ama n nya yi n mi kpelo , woku a pma zhin n miyi woi wan abyedo ɓe shekwoyi n cei .
ma wan ɓa n waʼazi yi nu , n mi zhin njesun n mi asese manayi nɓa abye , n na aɓo a wowoyi n wa zhin n mi abwai atuze n shekwoyi aba , vinya n zafun gyi-gyi-yi iko yi nu .
dna n zokwo ye , miku waʼazi zhin nabari manayi krisiti nya tunyi urushelima har ilirukum .
ama omi ɓeye nu , miye lo abye mi zhin waʼazi aba n kristi ye to si kpan , afa aba zado la ikklisiya shi .
mi vi shiri nu , nna cei kafi n litafi , aba n ishaya cige , “ aza n ɓa to shin kristi ye won ɓaɓa gye ɓa bwa awye ga . ”
behin-hin enyanu n kwo zhin mi n cei pma ma ɓe fya ba .
ama n na avun omi tnu-tnu ku zo n ya mi n shiri yi zhin lo ma ɓe n na aye awyekwo nya ye avun .
gama mi zhin shiri lo malo asbaniya n ma lo mi ɓei bma n roma , bayan yiku esa manayi bwa n na jeyi fye ɓei gnami ami .
ama kafin mi ɓe tilas malo urushelima malo a yesuviyi n cau-tai n ɓo .
gama fye gye , a yesuviyi n ɓa fi n makidoniya n akaya yi ɓaku enya ga ntu n na azaje ɓo n ɓa fi n urushelima ɓai sin wahala nyi .
ɓa ɓei zhin kwo n bugba bui-bui ntuge ɓa gyelo ɓa ntayi shi a yesuviyi lo nɓafi n urushelima .
ntu n kni ɓei ya ?
ntuge nabari manayi kristi nya kun n urushelima nu kwoi lo abyedo aba .
tunda ɓa ɓei gwo cauta zafun nya nabari manayi nya nɓenu ɓa gye ɓe n ɓa ɓa zhin ɓa , okwo nu ɓa gaɓa akaya nanyi nya .
sanu n ma gaɓa agyiwye ye , ma zo n ɓatnu-tnu manayi yei , mi ɓei ɓe ma gye fye wye mi-i lo asbaniya lo .
mi kpe lo sanu n mabe , dagayi ɓei gami anabarka ntu n fye ɓo , ma ɓefye n cei .
fye ɓa zhin aduwa ngnisun n miyi ?
ntu n dagayi yesu kristi ɓo , ntu nfye yeye ɓo nfye yemi nyi , n zafun gyi-gyi-yi ga fye-fye zhin aduwa n mwa n gnisun n miyi ntu mi tnu-tnu ɓo .
fye zhin aduwa n nyaho ta bwami n na aza kun n ɓa ta vi yesu kristi nyin , n ɓa fi n urushelima nyi .
fye zhin aduwa njesun n na yesu viyi ɓei gwo agyiwye n mi lo ɓa n cei nyi .
nnavun nmi ɓa mi ma ɓe of ye aba n bugba bui-bui dna n shekwoyi ɓeye , yi ɓa gaje kala .
nsayi ye , shekwoyi n wo ga bugba fu nyi , wo kun sun n fyei .
- 2 fibi nyikoza yesu viyi n kankriya zhimi ɓelo wa gye fye wye safyewyi .
woku tnu-tnu zhin n mwa n ikklisiya ye .
fye gwo wo n gye mapui dna n dagayi .
fyawu wo a yesu viyi yeye .
fye bma wo zhin n zokwo doho-dohoi n fye ɓami ntuge wo ku bma aza zhin n mwa dna n ɓa sangyi n mihin ɓe .
gna biriska n akilayi nge mi ɓiɓa gnaio , ɓa zhin omi atnu-tnu kun zhin yi nu dna kristi yesu .
ɓehin-hin , har oɓa wye-wyei ye kwa bwi n miɓo .
omi gmayin nu ta saɓa amin , har n abyedo n ikklisiya yi .
suku-suku fye ɓi aza gna n ɓa yezhi ɓa ci shekwoyi n ɓa puwa .
fye ɓi omi nugundo manayi gna abainatus .
owonu ɓei kmi yesu vi n asiya .
fye ɓi maryamu gna n wa zhin tnu-tnu n mwa n na bai wa bma yi zhin nyi .
fye ɓi andarinikus n yunuyas yi gna , omi bye n ɓa ɓei kunsun n miyi fi n kurkuku nyi .
amanzani gaɓa mwa-mwa .
ɓa ɓei ku vi yesu n mi abye .
fya ɓi ambiliyatus gna , oza n mi ye ngye shekwoyi ɓi .
n urbanus yi eyi tnutnu kunzhin yi , n istakiyi oza yeye yi .
fye ɓi abalis gna gami oza n dagayi ye , fya ɓi aza gna n ɓa fi ɓai zhin tnu-tnu n aristo bulus puwa nyi .
fye ɓi harodiyana omi bye gna , fya ɓi a yesuviyi gna n ɓa zhin afyenu fi n narkissus puwa nyi .
fye ɓi tarifaina gna n tarifusayi dagayi a tnu-tnuyi , n barsisa yi n wa zhin tnu-tnu mwa ga dagayi nyi .
fye ɓi rufus gna gami oza n dagayi a kni ga wohin , wa ze wonya , n wo iya yeyeyi , n wo la ze omi iya yeyeyi nyi .
suku-suku fya ɓi asinkiritus gna n filiguna , n harmisayi n batrubas yi n harmasayi n na aza jeyi n ɓa kusun n ɓayi .
fye ɓi flubugusa gna n juliya yi n niriyus yi , n wo mapuiyi n ulumbasayi , aza gyi-gyi-yi n ɓa kunsun n ɓai nyi .
fye dna aje abwado , ikklisiya n ya vinya tnu fye n ɓa gnaɓiyi .
nsaiye , ɓeda gmanyi n mi cei lo ma da kafin mi zo n wasika ye yi .
fye la pmiya n na aza n ɓaɓe n na ajegnayi ɓai shan aza gaiciya ga a shan .
ɓai ɓe n wuwuyi nkwo wu gbo , n doyi n aku wu fye .
a zayi pya ta zhin tnu-tnu ga eyi dagayi yesu nun , ama ɓaye gyiba ga ɓahin nu .
ɓa zhin a ɓeda kpedayi nu , aza nɓato ceceyin , ɓata wo ɓa kwoce dnan .
ama zaho-zahoi kpelo nge fye gni-a-gni lo cewo dna n gaiciya .
deye dami a gmalo .
miye fya sase cewo dna n nya n kwo bmiya , fya abwa kunya n nya n kwo to bmiyan .
safyewyi , shekwoyi bugbafu nya wo ɓa bma shaitan ya n fya pita sin ta .
anaɓarka nɓa kun n yi dagayi yesu kristi aba ɓa kun-sun n fyei .
timatawus omi tnu-tnu kun zhinyi , n lukiyus yi , n yasunayi , n susibatrus yi , omi ebye ɓa tnu fye n ɓa gna ɓiyi .
omi tartiyus n mi ka bulus wasikaye nyi , mi tnu fye n mi gnaɓiyi ce n gye yesu viyi do .
gayus wa gna nge mi ɓi fye gna ga wo , mi zhin wo zhiɓeyi nu , ikklisiya yezhi lo nwo puwa nu n ya .
arastus maʼaji , tnu fye n wo gnaɓiyi n lonu kawartus eyi zado .
sai n wyihoi , alheri dagayi yesu kristi nya kwo kunsun n fyei vinya .
- 27 mi fi fye n shekwoyi akun , n wo ɓa mi wa ga fye kala , fya mizhi n dagayi nyi shi nabari manayi da .
shi ma gna fye n wu nyi .
shekwoyi gni-gni shiri nyi ntu n fye ɓo abyedo n soshi tnuyi n sapa .
ama shi anabi ɓei ku pmada shi shekwoyi wa gbe , a zhin nabari ye waʼazi lo n na abaho-bahoi , n na bai aza vinya n na anyi , ɓa ga kristi gaiciya ɓa vi wo ɓo .
shekwoyi gmanyi n cece wum wo nu nyi , mwa-mwa kunsun n woi ntu n yesu kristi ɓo .
har nyalo-nyalo amin .
wasika ye gmi n bulus aba nu , n shekwoyi ɓei yiwo ntuge wa ze aza tnu-tnu yi yesu kristi nya , ɓedo n ʼyi zado yi na yiwo ge sastanisu nyi .
kwoi lo shekwoyi aza ʼba n korinto , n shekwoyi wa yiɓa ɓa ze wa za , woi la ɓa gwo dna n yesu kristi mi .
kwa lo aza ba vinya njesun nɓa yi yesu kristi , eyi dagayi nɓa nya yi .
shekwoyi eyi dada ɓedo n ʼyi dagayi yesu kristi yi , wo ga fye alheri n bugba fuyi .
mi zhin ma sa shekwoyi ami cici ntu alheri manayi ɓo n wa ga fye she fye ku ze yesu aza nyi .
wo ku fye ze anyabwayi n mwa .
wo ku bma fye zhin fyei da ɓo ga wo , woi la yekpe nunuyi ga fye dna gaiciya .
nya mi ɓei gna fye ge kristi ɓo mi wa zhin ga fye , kwo ku zhin .
fye la alheri doho-dohoi bwa nna anabarka yi n sayi ; zafun nyaga doho-dohoi n iko yi fya zhin wo ɓeye , ɓa zhin fye nya nu dna saye n na zhi ai pmi eyi dagayi yesu kristi jezeɓe nyi .
wo la ye har nyalonyalo ayi fye aza kni-kni-yi , tna laifi n ɓenukwoi yi dna wo nyipyei jezezhi nya .
shekwoyi ɓa zhin fye ɓeye ntna kma-kma , ntuge wo zhin wa zhin ɓo wa da cim-cim .
owoi nu na yi fye ge fya zhin nugundo nwo nugun yi yesu kristi .
ama , oma-zaje , mi gyi fye wye dna dagayi yesu kristi ʼye , fye ku ɓeda ajegna nya ya nfya tasin .
fye ku ze gmanyi , to ajegna lo aduwa nyakun m .
fye la ye ɓedo , efye ɓo nubo-zhin gmanyi , ɓemwi gmanyi njesun .
ntuge , omazaje , azaho n ɓa kun n kuluwi puwa ɓa ku gnami pei-pei nge fye wu anya lo n najeyi .
ntuge azaho cige , “ mi zhin bulus nya nu ” azaho cige , “ mi zhin bitrus nya nu . ” azaho cige , “ mi zhin bitrus nya nu . ” aza ho ge , “ mi zhin apollos nya nu . ” azaho kwa ɓai cige , “ mi zhin yesu nya nu . ”
fyela yesu gnajeya wyiwo-wyiwo .
omi , bulus , nu ɓei fi ntu fya laifi ɓo ?
a ɓei zhin fye batisma dna n bulus eyenu ?
ma gode n shekwoyi ntuge mi to ɓei zhin zaho batisma n fye m akpege krisbus ɓedo n gayus
ntuce nu zaho-zaho yi ta mi wa cige gye mi ya oɓo woyi mi-i shi “ bulus aduwa nyakun m . ”
e , kuwa , mi ɓei ku batisma zhin istifanus a puwa da ama mi ta shan zaho ɓo palon n mi ɓei zhin wo batisma m .
yesu to ɓei tnumi ma zhin batisma num , ama ma zhin waʼazi nabari manayi nya .
mi to zhin waʼazi n na ɓeda ayakwoi fi aza ɓeyekpe nyam , kada ko wun iko ya n ko dna n waʼazi fa-fayi yesu zundu nya nyi .
gama yesu fi-fi ti zundu nabari ko zhin gbolo-yi nu n aza bwi-bwi-yi aba .
ama n eyi aza gni-gni-yi aba , ko zhin shekwoyi iko nu .
ntuge shekwoyi wa cige , “ miɓa ze aza zokwo gni-gni nya gboloyi , kwo ko ɓei bmiya n ɓa ba wuna , har ɓeda n na ɓo nubo-zhin a ɓeyekpei agbamgbam nya yi . ”
to mi gye awyega da , aɓeyekpei n naza yi n ɓa mi n gbegyi tu na anyi nya tukwo nyi .
shekwoyi ku ɓa ze amama da , woi ku wu ge oɓa wyega zhin gboloyi nu .
gama shekwoyi dna n wa wyega , wa ku kpe ge anyi ta kpe wo ye dna naza wyegam .
amma wa zhin ntuge wa gni aza dna n waʼazi zhin mi , n nanyi gye ko ge gboloyi nyi .
ko ze gboloyi nu na yahudiyi aba ntuge ɓa ye tuze n ʼshe kwa wu ge oɓo na zhin ko waʼazi nyi , ko zhin gaiciya nu , kwoi ze gboloyi nu n na heleniyi aba , ntuge ɓa bwa nya gaiciya nu ga n ko lodo nɓa ɓonubo-zhin yi , nɓa wyega yi jesun .
ntu cenu sa ya zhin waʼazi ge yesu wa fi wa gni ɓa nu , ayahudiyi ta ye ɓedayem ko fyewyi .
